jobs.title: Développeur / Expert Keycloak & Java (IAM & MFA) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au sein de l'équipe Sécurité & Identité (IAM / CIAM), vous serez responsable de la conception, de la personnalisation et de l'intégration de la solution d'authentification et de gestion des accès Keycloak. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'implémentation de parcours d'authentification sécurisés (MFA) et le développement de modules Java sur mesure.

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

Litt om meg og stillingen

Jeg er en 76 år gammel dame som bor på Tomasjord sammen med min mann. Jeg søker en pålitelig og omsorgsfull person som kan hjelpe meg med nattevakten. Jeg setter pris på tydelighet og omsorg, og ønsker meg en hyggelig arbeidssituasjon.

  • være til stede i hjemmet og bistå med forflytning ved bruk av personheis.
  • hjelpe til med personlig hygiene og andre behov som måtte oppstå i løpet av natten

Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • er fleksibel og har god arbeidsmoral.
  • er observant, lyttende og kommuniserer godt.
  • har forståelse for funksjonsnedsettelser og kan håndtere stressende situasjoner på en rolig måte.
  • har et godt humør og bidrar til en positiv arbeidssituasjon.
  • snakker flytende norsk og kan fremvise politiattest.
  • er komfortabel med et hjem hvor det røykes.
  • Erkjennelse av og respekt for privatliv er viktig.

Praktisk informasjon:

  • Stillingen passer best for en kvinne på grunn av arbeidsoppgavene.
  • Opplæring i bruk av utstyr vil bli gitt.
  • God fysikk er en fordel da forflytning med personheis inngår i arbeidsoppgavene.

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

Fra og med oktober har jeg ledig to faste nattevaktstillinger.

  • Fast nattevaktstilling, ca. 50 %
  • Fast nattevaktstilling, ca. 55 %

Arbeidstid: kl. 23.00 - 07.30

Stillingene følger en fast 6-ukers turnus med forhåndsdefinerte arbeidsdager. Arbeidsdagene kan ikke endres, da de er tilpasset eksisterende grunnturnus.

Dersom du ønsker en noe større eller mindre stillingsprosent, er jeg åpen for dialog om dette. Vi finner gjerne en løsning dersom det lar seg gjøre.

Ved ansettelse vil du få tilgang til gjeldende turnusplan, slik at du har full oversikt over hvilke dager du skal arbeide gjennom hele turnusperioden.


Mye mer enn bare penger

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet!   • Verneombud | Bedriftshelsetjeneste

Vil DU bidra til en bedre hverdag for mennesker med assistansebehov, samtidig som du får en spennende CV?

jobs.title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
jobs.description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?

jobs.title: Kvinne i 50-årene med mange interesser søker BPA-assistenter

Hvem er du?
Jeg trenger assistent på dagtid, kveldstid og i helger, i ca. 50% stilling: opp til 17,5 timer i gjennomsnitt per uke. I perioder kan det bli aktuelt å jobbe mer enn dine faste timer.

Førerkort er et krav. Jeg trenger deg som kommer tidsnok og kan være med rundt i hverdagen. Jeg har bil med manuelt gir som du må kjøre.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Jobben spenner fra hjelp av personlig karakter til husarbeid og sosiale aktiviteter. Mer får du vite i et eventuelt intervju.

Hva kreves av deg?

  • Fleksibel

  • Selvstendighet er en god egenskap, men du må kunne la deg bli ledet.

Stillingstype: Deltid

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

jobs.title: Hjemmetjenesten søker
jobs.description:
Hjemmetjenesten i Ringsaker har ansvar for å yte hjemmebaserte helse- og omsorgstjenester til innbyggerne i Ringsaker. Stillingen som lyses ut er for tiden underlagt Sone 1, med base i Brumunddal. 

Hjemmetjenesten har fokus på å gi pasientene tjenester av høy kvalitet og tilrettelegge for helhetlig omsorg i alle livsfaser. Vi har fokus på forebygging og mestring, og våre ansatte er en viktig ressurs for å lykkes med dette.

Vår visjon er at vi skal bli "Norges beste hjemmetjeneste", og vi vil ha med deg som ønsker å bidra til dette på laget!

Vi søker:

To sykepleiere i 100 % fast stilling i Enhet for hjemmetjenester, Sone 1. 

To sykepleiere i 100% stilling, vikariat, inntil 12 måneders varighet.

Vi ønsker en kollega som er engasjert, lojal, fleksibel og omstillingsdyktig. Du må være svært selvstendig og kunne takle en variert og til tider uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag, høyt tempo og plutselige endringer. Vi forventer at du vil være en positiv og aktiv bidragsyter til arbeidsmiljøet vårt. Enheten er i en pågående prosess med samlokalisering av flere avdelinger i hjemmetjenesten, og vi ser derfor etter en sykepleier som for utenom andre ansvarsoppgaver også er interessert i å bidra aktivt inn i dette arbeidet og som vil være med å utvikle tjenesten videre. 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Hjemmesykepleie utfra den enkeltes behov
  • Utførelse av ulike spesialiserte sykepleie-prosedyrer
  • Legemiddelhåndtering
  • Kartlegging og klinisk vurdering av pasienter 
  • Oppfølging av trygghetsalarmer og akuttmedisinske vurderinger hos pasienter med endringer i sykdomsbildet
  • Tett dialog og tverrfaglig samarbeid internt og med øvrige hjelpeinstanser
  • Dokumentasjon og oppfølging av pasientjournal
  • Primær/sekundær ansvar for enkeltpasienter
  • Definerte ansvarsområder i avdeling/enhet ut fra behov, kompetanse og interessefelt
  • Veiledning og internundervisning av kollegaer, sykepleiestudenter og nyansatte
  • Deltagelse i samarbeids- og behandlingsmøter

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Gjennomført videreutdanning i sårbehandling eller påbegynt slik videreutdanning er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Erfaring fra hjemmebasert omsorg er ønskelig, eventuelt annen, relevant erfaring som sykepleier
  • Erfaring med endringsprosesser og omorganisering er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Erfaring med yngre pasienter og pasienter med sammensatte behov herunder rus- og eller psykisk sykdom er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Førerkort klasse B 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Gode samarbeidsevner og fleksibilitet
  • Godt humør og løsningsfokus
  • Evne til både å arbeide effektivt og prioritere når det er påkrevd
  • Aktiv bidragsyter i arbeids- og fagmiljø
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og ta ansvar for ulike fagområder
  • Lojal og pliktoppfyllende
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Muligheten til å være med og videreutvikle hjemmetjenesten i Innlandets største kommune og dens faglige standard og innhold
  • Faglig dyktig og høykompetent team av hyggelige kollegaer, spennende utfordringer og stadig mer avanserte oppgaver som krever faglig kompetanse og et godt, klinisk blikk
  • Høy grad av selvstendighet og faglig ansvar
  • Sosialt og godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet for faglig meransvar innenfor ulike, spesifikke fagområder
  • Fri tilgang på ulike kompetansehevende tiltak via e-læring, tilbud om kurs, internundervisning m.m.
  • Grundig opplæring og fadderordning i prøvetiden
  • Gode pensjonsordninger

Avlønning/vilkår:

Årslønn i 100 % stilling: Sykepleier 570 400 ,- -  664 900 ,-* Spesialsykepleier: 611 400,- - 698 200,- * (* Årslønnen inkluderer et lokalt rekrutteringstillegg på kr 25 000.)

Arbeidstid dag/kveld med for tiden arbeid tredje hver helg.

Annet:

Politiattest av nyere dato må fremvises før tiltredelse (ikke eldre enn 3 måneder). Elektronisk søknad og CV registreres via våre nettsider. Attester og vitnemål lastes inn som vedlegg til søknaden. Ved interne opprykk eller øvrig ledighet innad i avdelingen som følge av tilsettingsprosessen, vil aktuelle søkermasse kunne bli benyttet for tilsetting i mindre stillingsbrøk eller vikariater. 

I henhold til offentleglova § 25, kan opplysninger om søker unntas i offentlig søkerliste dersom søkeren selv ber om det. Det gjøres oppmerksom på at en søknad kan bli gjort offentlig selv om søkeren har bedt om å ikke bli ført opp søkerlista. Søkeren vil i tilfellet bli varslet om dette.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ringsaker kommune er med sine om lag 36.000 innbyggere den klart største kommunen i Innlandet. Kommunen har vekst i folketall og arbeidsplasser og et offensivt næringsliv som satser og ønsker utvikling. Ringsaker er Norges største hyttekommune, og Sjusjøen er kjent for å ha Norges beste skiløyper. Småbyene Brumunddal og Moelv har urbane kvaliteter, og det er et mangfoldig botilbud i hele kommunen. Det er gode oppvekstmiljøer, god barnehagedekning og en satsing på økt læringsutbytte i skolen. Mjøsa og det vakre kulturlandskapet gir fantastiske muligheter for rekreasjon og opplevelser. Vil du jobbe i en av Norges mest offensive kommuner? Som arbeidstaker i Ringsaker, blir du en del av et stort og sammensatt fagmiljø med gode kollegaer. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

 - This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).

 - Manage executive-level product escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.

 - The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.

 - Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.

 - Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.

 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross-functionally owned processes and tools.

 - Participate in the global on-call rotation to cover incidents.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 3+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.

 - You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.

 - You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

 - You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

 - You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

 - Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.

 - Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go-to-market and technical teams.

 - Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.

jobs.title: Ressorucepædagog til Mælkevejen
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et børnemiljø, hvor alle børn kan lykkes med dem, de er?
Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk ressourcepædagog, der brænder for at skabe gode rammer for børns trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskabet.

Om Mælkevejen 
I Mælkevejen tror vi på, at alle børn kommer med unikke ressourcer, personligheder og måder at være i verden på. Vores opgave som voksne er at skabe et trygt og udviklende børnemiljø, hvor børn oplever sig set, forstået og betydningsfulde – og hvor der er plads til forskellighed.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe inkluderende fællesskaber, hvor alle børn får mulighed for at lykkes med dem, de er. Det gør vi ved at arbejde med sensitive samspil og meningsfulde fællesskaber, hvor de voksne tager ansvar for at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Vores pædagogiske tilgang bygger på ICDP (International Child Development Programme), hvor relationen mellem barn og voksen er fundamentet for barnets trivsel, udvikling og læring. Vi møder børnene med nysgerrighed, anerkendelse og et ressourceorienteret børnesyn og arbejder ud fra en forståelse af, at det er de voksnes ansvar at justere rammerne og skabe de bedste muligheder for, at alle børn kan være en del af fællesskabet.

Vi har fokus på tidlig indsats og på at opdage og handle på børns behov i tæt samarbejde med kolleger, forældre og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere. Samtidig ved vi, at det gode børneliv også skabes gennem leg, varme, humor, nysgerrighed og voksne, der kan begejstres sammen med børnene.

Om stillingen
Som ressourcepædagog er du tilknyttet hele Mælkevejen og arbejder på tværs af alle stuer. Du bliver en central faglig ressource, der understøtter både børn, medarbejdere og læringsmiljøer gennem sparring, vejledning og målrettede pædagogiske indsatser.

Du har ikke ansvaret for en fast børnegruppe, men bevæger dig derhen, hvor behovet er størst. Din opgave er at understøtte den pædagogiske kvalitet i hele huset og bidrage til, at alle børn får de bedste muligheder for at trives, udvikle sig og deltage aktivt i fællesskabet.

Du har en afgørende rolle i arbejdet med tidlig indsats og inkluderende læringsmiljøer. Du omsætter pædagogisk og specialpædagogisk viden til praksis og understøtter kolleger gennem faglig sparring, refleksion og vejledning. Samtidig er du med til at sikre, at indsatser bliver systematiske, sammenhængende og forankret i den daglige praksis.

Vi har allerede en dygtig og erfaren ressourcepædagog i Mælkevejen, som du vil komme til at indgå i et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med. Sammen vil I være med til at styrke den fælles pædagogiske retning, dele viden og understøtte udviklingen af inkluderende læringsmiljøer i hele børnehaven. 
I bliver faglige sparringspartnere for hinanden og får mulighed for at kvalificere indsatser, reflektere over praksis og sammen skabe endnu stærkere rammer for børnenes trivsel og udvikling.

Som ressourcepædagog er du en synlig og tillidsvækkende fagperson, der går foran i udviklingen af den pædagogiske praksis. Du evner at skabe følgeskab gennem stærke relationer, tydelig kommunikation og en anerkendende tilgang til dine kolleger. Du inspirerer ikke ved at have alle svarene, men ved at være nysgerrig, reflekterende og ved at omsætte faglig viden til handling i hverdagen.

Du har mod til at tage initiativ og sætte retning, også når hverdagen er kompleks, eller når situationer kalder på hurtige faglige vurderinger. Du kan bevare roen, skabe overblik og understøtte kolleger i at finde fælles løsninger, når et barn eller en børnegruppe udfordrer den pædagogiske praksis. Du tør gå forrest, facilitere faglige refleksioner og bidrage med nye perspektiver – altid med respekt for dine kollegers erfaringer og med fokus på at skabe et fælles fagligt fundament.

Humor, ro og et positivt mindset i en kompleks hverdag
Vi arbejder i en hverdag med højt tempo, mange forskellige behov og komplekse pædagogiske problemstillinger, hvor opgaverne ofte kræver både faglighed, fleksibilitet og evnen til at bevare overblikket.

Som ressourcepædagog er det afgørende, at du kan møde en omskiftelig hverdag med ro, nysgerrighed og en tro på, at der findes muligheder og løsninger – også når situationerne er krævende. Du skal kunne skabe tryghed omkring dig, bidrage til en positiv stemning og hjælpe med at finde retning, når kompleksiteten bliver stor.

Et smil, et grin og evnen til at kunne se muligheder sammen med kollegerne er med til at skabe energi og arbejdsglæde – og samtidig styrke vores evne til at lykkes med den vigtige opgave, vi har omkring børnene.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Understøtte udviklingen af inkluderende læringsmiljøer på tværs af Mælkevejen.
  • Bidrage til tidlig opsporing og forebyggende indsatser.
  • Vejlede og sparre med kolleger om pædagogiske strategier, relationer, struktur og deltagelsesmuligheder.
  • Gå foran i den pædagogiske praksis og være et fagligt forbillede, der omsætter viden til handling.
  • Facilitere faglige refleksioner og bidrage til udviklingen af en fælles pædagogisk retning.
  • Tage lederskab i komplekse pædagogiske situationer og understøtte kolleger i at skabe ro, overblik og handlemuligheder.
  • Indgå i målrettede pædagogiske forløb med børn og børnegrupper, når der er behov.
  • Bidrage til dokumentation, evaluering og opfølgning på indsatser.
  • Samarbejde tæt med ledelsen om udviklingen af den pædagogiske kvalitet.
  • Indgå i et anerkendende samarbejde med forældre.
  • Deltage aktivt i det tværfaglige samarbejde med blandt andet PPR, tale-hørekonsulent, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut og psykolog.
  • Bidrage til videndeling og kompetenceudvikling blandt medarbejderne.

Vi søger en ressorucepædagog som

  • Er uddannet pædagog - gerne med erfaring indenfor børn og familier i udsatte positioner 
  • Har erfaring med eller stor interesse for inkluderende pædagogik, tidlig indsats og specialpædagogiske tilgange.
  • Har kendskab til eller interesse for at arbejde ud fra ICDP.
  • Kan skabe følgeskab og motivere kolleger gennem faglighed, tillid og stærke relationer.
  • Har mod til at tage lederskab i komplekse pædagogiske situationer og bidrager til at skabe ro, retning og fælles løsninger.
  • Trives med at facilitere faglige refleksioner og udviklingsprocesser tæt på praksis.
  • Kan balancere en vejledende rolle med et tæt og ligeværdigt samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Er tydelig, handlekraftig og vedholdende, samtidig med at du møder andre med nysgerrighed, respekt og ydmyghed.
  • Har et positivt mindset og kan bevare roen i komplekse situationer
  • Har stærke relationskompetencer og kan skabe tillid hos både børn, kolleger og forældre.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende funktion med stor mulighed for at præge den pædagogiske udvikling i hele Mælkevejen.
  • En central rolle som kulturbærer og sparringspartner for kolleger og ledelse.
  • En arbejdsplads hvor ICDP danner den fælles pædagogiske referenceramme.
  • Gode muligheder for tværfaglig sparring med blandt andet PPR og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • Et engageret kollegafællesskab med fokus på refleksion, videndeling og fælles udvikling.
  • En ledelse, der prioriterer nærvær, udvikling og høj kvalitet i den pædagogiske praksis.
  • Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø med høj grad af tillid, hvor du får mulighed for selvstændigt at rammesætte og strukturere dine arbejdsopgaver 

 

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 35-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. August 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Linda Hosseini Garmi, Pædagogisk Leder, på 28920824/29450603 eller via mail linda.garmi@glostrup.dk.
Det anbefales at sende en sms, hvis ikke det er muligt at komme igennem telefonisk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og til at byde en ny ressourcepædagog velkommen i Mælkevejen.

Portier

We are looking for a professional, courteous, and service-oriented Portier who is passionate about hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences for our Boutique Hotel in the heart of Copenhagen. As one of the first and last team members our guests encounter, you play a vital role in ensuring every arrival and departure leaves a lasting impression.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys being active throughout the day, and takes pride in delivering service with attention to detail. You are approachable, proactive, and professional, with the ability to remain calm and organized even during busy periods.

As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the daily operation of a luxury 5-star boutique hotel while working alongside dedicated colleagues who share a passion for excellence, teamwork, and genuine hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests warmly upon arrival and wish them a memorable farewell upon departure.

  • Assist guests with luggage to and from their rooms.

  • Support the Front Office team with arrivals, departures, and ensuring a seamless check-in experience.

  • Open doors and escort guests throughout the hotel when needed.

  • Provide information about the hotel, its facilities, and local attractions.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming entrance, lobby, and surrounding guest areas.

  • Coordinate with Hosts, Housekeeping, and other departments to deliver a seamless guest experience.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests with discretion and attention to detail.

  • Assist with luggage storage, deliveries, and other operational tasks as required.

  • Help create a warm, welcoming atmosphere that reflects the hotel's high service standards.

What We Offer

  • A key role in creating memorable first and last impressions for our guests.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious luxury 5-star boutique hotel.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • A supportive and professional team environment where collaboration, hospitality, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

  • A workplace with high ambitions, short decision-making processes, and the freedom to take responsibility.

  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in hospitality, customer service, or a guest-facing role is an advantage, but not essential.

  • You are friendly, approachable, and genuinely enjoy creating great guest experiences.

  • You work in a structured and reliable manner while taking responsibility for your tasks.

  • You communicate confidently and professionally in English; additional languages are an advantage.

  • You remain calm under pressure and can maintain a positive attitude during busy periods.

  • You are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have excellent attention to detail and take pride in maintaining high standards.

  • You are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required.

  • If the role includes valet parking, a valid driver's license is an advantage but not required for all candidates.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle pariskunnalle Harjavaltaan
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattisille asiakkaille

Haemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattisia asiakkaitamme Harjavallassa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemista

Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 14,82-16,82 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

Notre client est un acteur reconnu du tourisme social en France, engagé dans une démarche de vacances accessibles à tous, avec un réseau de villages vacances implantés dans des environnements naturels privilégiés. Pour l'un de leur site situé à Pornichet, nous recherchons leur futur :

Responsable d'établissement Touristique H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre forfait 216 jours
Primes sur objectif
Maison de fonction disposant de 4 chambres
Autres avantages : CET, chèques vacances


Vos motivations :
Rejoignez un groupe engagé, porteur de valeurs humaines fortes, où l'accessibilité, la convivialité et la qualité de l'accueil sont au cœur de l'expérience client. Evoluez dans un environnement en transformation, en lien direct avec les équipes terrain et les vacanciers, et jouer un rôle clé dans la qualité du séjour proposé. Vous êtes intéressé par un poste vous permettant d'être force de proposition pour améliorer l'existant, optimiser l'organisation et fidéliser les équipes. Rejoignez un groupe à un moment clé de son histoire, désireux d'améliorer la qualité au sein de ses sites.

Vos missions :
Leadership stratégique : Capacité à déployer la vision stratégique Groupe au niveau de l'établissement.
Gestion opérationnelle : Supervision quotidienne des activités : hébergement (120 chambres + une dizaine de gites), restauration (250 couverts au restaurant, 6 salles de séminaire), animation (bar, mini-golf, aire de jeux.), et maintenance.
Management : jusqu'à 35-40 collaborateurs en pleine saison dont la moitié dédiée à la restauration. Les chefs de service en CDI à l'année.
Service client : Orientation client et engagement à offrir une expérience exceptionnelle et mémorable pour la fidélisation clients
Innovation : Aptitude à introduire des concepts novateurs pour améliorer l'attrait de l'établissement.
Gestion financière : Compétences en gestion budgétaire, maîtrise des coûts et optimisation des revenus.

Votre profil : Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion (Bac +2 minimum), vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie à un poste similaire en hôtellerie, résidence de tourisme ou village vacances. Vous avez l'habitude d'évoluer dans des environnements à forte saisonnalité et à volume. Organisé et réactif, vous savez gérer les priorités et faire face aux imprévus. Votre sens du service, votre proximité terrain et votre capacité à fédérer les équipes sont essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction. Polyvalent, vous intervenez aussi bien sur des sujets opérationnels que managériaux, avec une forte orientation client.

jobs.title: CNC TURNER / SWISS-TYPE CNC MACHINIST – VALTIMO COMPONENTS OYJ
jobs.description:
CNC TURNER / SWISS-TYPE CNC MACHINIST – VALTIMO COMPONENTS OYJ

**Would you like to do more than simply run pre-programmed jobs?**

Valtimo Components Oyj is looking for a skilled **CNC Turner / Swiss-Type CNC Machinist** to join our team in Valtimo, Finland, in a permanent position.

We are growing and investing strongly in our production capabilities. Our latest investment is a **Citizen Cincom Series 3 L20-XII LFV Swiss-type CNC lathe**, which strengthens our turning capacity and opens up new opportunities for manufacturing demanding, high-precision components.

We are looking for a machinist who wants to take responsibility for their own work, develop their skills, and work with modern CNC technology.

What does the job involve?

Depending on your skills and experience, your responsibilities will include:

- CNC turning and/or Swiss-type CNC machining

- machine setup and tooling

- creating and modifying CNC programs

- measuring finished components and ensuring product quality

- developing machining processes and production together with the rest of our team


We especially value experience in **CNC turning, Citizen Swiss-type CNC lathes, Fanuc controls, or similar machines and control systems**.

However, you do not need to know everything from day one.

If you have solid basic machining skills and the motivation to develop into a skilled Swiss-type CNC machining professional, we can provide training for the role.

What do we offer?

We offer:

- a permanent employment contract

- modern and continuously developing CNC machinery

- the opportunity to work with our new **Citizen L20-XII LFV** and our versatile range of other CNC machines

- the opportunity to take responsibility for your own work and contribute to the development of our production

- varied and technically demanding components to manufacture

- salary progression based on your skills and professional development

- a stable position in a growing Finnish manufacturing company


To be considered for the position, we require:

- a **vocational qualification in machining, mechanical engineering, metalwork, or a related technical field**, or ongoing studies toward a relevant qualification

- basic knowledge and understanding of CNC machining

- a careful and quality-focused approach to work

- willingness to learn, develop your skills, and take responsibility for your own work

- Applicants must have a valid right to work in Finland. Depending on the assigned duties, the position may be subject to a security clearance.


Previous experience in CNC turning, Swiss-type CNC machining, Citizen machines, Fanuc controls, machine setup, or CNC programming is considered an advantage.

We manufacture high-precision components for demanding industries, including **high-tech, defence, medical technology and electronics**.

With us, you can see the tangible results of your own work in the finished products.

Salary

Your salary will be determined based on your experience and skills.

**Indicative salary range: approximately €15–22/hour + shift allowances and other applicable supplements.**

For experienced and versatile CNC professionals, the final salary will be agreed based on your level of expertise.

Interested?

Send us a short application or your CV.

You are also welcome to contact us directly to discuss the position without submitting a formal application first.

**Valtimo Components Oyj** Valtimo, North Karelia, Finland

**An efficient and reliable part of your supply chain.**

jobs.title: Alueohjaaja
jobs.employer: Lounais-Suomen Lihastautiyhdistys ry, ruotsiksi Sydvästra Finlands Muskelhandikappförening rf
jobs.description:
Työntekijämme siirtyy uusiin haasteisiin ja ihanassa työyhteisössämme vapautuu henkilökohtaisen avun alueohjaajan paikka Turussa.

Alueohjaaja toimii osana henkilökohtaisen avun toiminnan tiimiä. Alueohjaajina toimivilla on omat vastuukuntansa, joissa toimintaa koordinoidaan itsenäisesti yhteisin laatuperiaattein. Turun osalta toimintaa koordinoidaan työparityönä siten, että kummallakin alueohjaajalla on omat postipiirialueensa. Työ on pääosin päivätyötä, mutta sisältää etukäteen sovittuja ilta- ja viikonlopputapahtumia. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on oltava, koska työhön sisältyy liikkumista omalla toimialueella.

Alueohjaajan tehtävänä on koordinoida ja kehittää Avustajakeskuksen palkallista toimintaa sekä Tuettu työsuhde®-palvelua yhteistyössä työntekijöiden ja paikallisten verkostojen kanssa. Alueohjaaja rekrytoi, ohjaa ja neuvoo henkilökohtaisen avun työnantajia ja avustajia heidän tehtävässään. Alueohjaaja osallistuu tapahtumien järjestämiseen ja toimii markkinoinnissa yhteistyössä vapaaehtoistoiminnan kanssa. Lisäksi alueohjaaja osallistuu muihin yhdistyksen toiminnan toteuttamista koskeviin tehtäviin tarvittaessa. Työhön kuuluu myös viestintätehtäviä.

Me toivomme tulevalta työkaverilta aktiivista ja itsenäistä työotetta, tiimitaitoja, esiintymiskykyä, taipumusta innovatiiviseen ajatteluun sekä rautaista kokemusta asioiden loppuun viemisestä. Henkilökohtaisen avun tuntemus ja kokemus järjestötehtävien koordinoinnista nähdään meillä isona valttina.

Avustajakeskus tarjoaa sinulle koko työyhteisön tuen, aktiivisen tiimin ja mahdollisuuden kehittää itseäsi järjestötyön ammattilaisena. Avustajakeskus on työpaikkana eteenpäin suuntaava, yksilöt huomioiva ja rinnallasi kulkeva avoin yhteisö, joka odottaa samaa avoimuutta ja luotettavuutta myös sinulta.

Toivomme hakijalta AMK-tasoista soveltavaa koulutusta, esim. sosiaalialan, terveydenhuollon tai yhteisöpedagogin koulutus antaa hyvän pohjan. Huomioimme vaihtoehtoisesti myös pidemmän työkokemuksen järjestötoiminnassa sovellettavasti.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä. Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.

Hakijalta toivotaan kokemusta:

- työsuhdeasioista, lainsäädännöstä ja työehtosopimuksista

- järjestötyöstä

- koordinointi- ja kehittämistehtävistä

- viestinnästä ja markkinoinnista

- vaikuttamistyön tekemisestä

- tapahtumien järjestämisestä

- sosiaalisen median käyttämisestä


Hakijalla on oltava hyvät sosiaaliset taidot. Lisäksi toivomme

- innovatiivisuutta

- hyvää suullista ja kirjallista ilmaisutaitoa

- esiintymiskykyä

- kykyä verkostoitua

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- halua kehittää toimintaa


Hakijalla tulee olla oman auton käyttömahdollisuus, sillä työn toteuttaminen vaatii oman auton käyttöä. Katsomme eduksi ruotsin ja englannin kielen taidon ja erilaisten sähköisten järjestelmien käyttämiskokemuksen.

jobs.title: Kokkeja Leville! Chef to Levi!
jobs.description:
Lounaskokkeja ja À la Carte -kokkeja Leville talvikaudelle 2027


Lunch Chefs & À la Carte Chefs Wanted for Levi – Winter Season 2027


Haluatko viettää talven Lapin upeissa maisemissa ja työskennellä osana ammattitaitoista keittiötiimiä? Nyt on mahdollisuutesi!


Dreaming of spending the winter in Finnish Lapland while working in a professional kitchen? This is your opportunity!

Haemme asiakkaallemme motivoituneita lounaskokkeja sekä À la Carte -kokkeja Leville talvikaudelle 2027. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä vilkkaassa ja laadukkaassa ravintolassa, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa, hyvää asennetta ja tiimityötä.

We are looking for motivated Lunch Chefs and À la Carte Chefs for our client in Levi for the 2027 winter season. Join a busy, high-quality restaurant where professionalism, teamwork and a positive attitude are valued every day.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


Lounaskokki | Lunch Chef


Työtehtävät | Your responsibilities

 * Päivittäisen lounasbuffetin valmistus
 * Suosittujen à la carte -annosten valmistus, mukaan lukien ravintolan tunnetut kanakorit
 * Työpisteen siisteydestä ja hygieniasta huolehtiminen
 * Työskentely osana suurta ja ammattitaitoista keittiötiimiä
 * Preparing the daily lunch buffet
 * Preparing popular à la carte dishes, including the restaurants well-known chicken baskets
 * Maintaining a clean and hygienic workstation
 * Working as part of a large and professional kitchen team

Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa aamusta alkuiltaan. Ravintola on avoinna viikon jokaisena päivänä.

Shifts are mainly scheduled from morning until early evening. The restaurant is open seven days a week.

------------------------------------------------------------------------


À la Carte -kokki | À la Carte Chef


Työtehtävät | Your responsibilities

 * Laadukkaiden ja näyttävästi esille laitettujen annosten valmistus
 * Sujuva työskentely myös kiireisimpinä palveluaikoina
 * Korkean laadun ylläpitäminen jokaisessa annoksessa
 * Yhteistyö muun keittiötiimin kanssa sujuvan palvelun varmistamiseksi
 * Preparing high-quality, beautifully presented dishes
 * Performing efficiently during busy service hours
 * Maintaining the highest quality in every dish served
 * Working closely with the kitchen team to ensure smooth service
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Odotamme sinulta | What we expect

 * Vähintään 2 vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä Suomessa
 * Kokin koulutus katsotaan eduksi
 * Sitoutumista koko talvikaudeksi
 * Hyvää työasennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja tiimityötaitoja
 * At least two years of professional chef experience in Finland
 * Culinary education is considered an advantage
 * Commitment for the entire winter season
 * Positive attitude, initiative and strong teamwork skills
------------------------------------------------------------------------


 Tarjoamme | What we offer

 * Kilpailukykyisen palkan
 * Asumismahdollisuuden (veloitus asumismuodon mukaan)
 * Mahdollisuuden henkilöstöhintaisiin hissilippuihin, lasketteluvälineisiin ja muihin henkilöstöetuihin
 * Rennon mutta ammattimaisen työympäristön
 * Kokoaikatyötä joulukuun puolivälistä pääsiäiseen saakka
 * Mahdollisuuden viettää unohtumaton talvi Suomen suosituimmassa hiihtokeskuksessa
 * Competitive salary
 * Accommodation available (cost depends on accommodation type)
 * Staff benefits including ski passes, ski equipment and other employee perks
 * A relaxed yet professional working environment
 * Full-time employment from mid-December until Easter
 * A unique opportunity to spend the winter in Finlands most popular ski resort
------------------------------------------------------------------------


Tule viettämään talvi Leville!


Spend Your Winter in Levi!

Työskentely Lapissa on paljon enemmän kuin pelkkä työpaikka – se on elämys. Päiväsi voivat alkaa tunturin juurella ja päättyä revontulten loisteeseen. Jos etsit unohtumatonta talvikautta ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi huippusesongin keskellä, tämä työ on sinua varten.

Working in Lapland is more than just a job—it is an experience. Imagine starting your day at the foot of the fells and ending it beneath the Northern Lights. If youre looking for an unforgettable winter season while developing your culinary skills in one of Finlands busiest destinations, wed love to hear from you.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lähetä hakemuksesi mielellään CV kera. CV on suositeltava, mutta ei pakollinen.

Please submit your application, preferably including your CV. A CV is appreciated but not required.

jobs.title: Business development manager m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
As a 'Business Development Manager' at Safran Trusted 4D, you'll lead growth initiatives and strategic customer engagement for our precision Timing & Synchronization portfolio across defense, commercial, and critical infrastructure markets. You'll drive partner relationships, identify new market opportunities, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver mission-critical timing solutions in GNSS-contested environments.



The Day to Day looks like:

o Gather market data and generate Market Surveys and approaches to market

for assigned territories.

o Lead customer and end-user relationships across ST4D Timing portfolio.

o Ensure a long-term strategic partnership is maintained with all the BP's and

end-users.

o Provide product and Sales training to approved BP's.

o Provide technical input to BP's and End-users for requests.

o Review pipelines with BP's and open opportunities with End-users including.

o Contribute to S1 and S2 bid reviews.

o Initiate and assist BP due diligence.

o Support post-sales support queries that are complex and require onsite

customer engagement.

o Business development of ST4D Timing portfolio in new and after-sales

market.

o Maintain on-going customer relationships, ensure customer satisfaction.

o Participation and follow-up of meetings, report writing.

o Interact and co-ordinate closely with all levels within the company (sales,

support, program, finance).

o Ensure a constant awareness of market tenders, budgets, geopolitical context

and regulation as they impact the Defense and Commercial Timing and

Simulation markets within your territory.

o Contribute to internal road maps, issuing marketing analysis and propose

action plans to develop the business in your territory.

Freelance 3D Architectural Modeller (3ds Max) - Remote, UK Hours

The Role

We're looking for a detail oriented 3D architectural modeller. Youâll be working on a combination of projects including large scale exteriors, context buildings, landscape, interior spaces, and furniture. The sources you work from will vary between CAD drawings, Revit exports, sketches, PDFs, or photo references. You'll need to interpret incomplete or inconsistent information confidently and know what to ask for.

What You'll Do

  • Analyse the project brief and organise the information you have, flagging any issues or inconsistencies.
  • Formulate a modelling plan with time estimations and the final output details.
  • Read architectural plans accurately and export models where needed.
  • Model architecture, interiors, furniture, and site context in 3ds Max from varied source material (DWG, Revit exports, sketches, PDFs, photos)
  • Prepare scenes for handover to visualisation artists: clean topology, logical naming, correct real-world scale, organised layers
  • Build vegetation and repeating-element setups using Forest Pack and RailClone
  • Ensure compatibility with a Corona render workflow (proxies, material slots, scene hygiene)
  • Manage your own workload against agreed deadlines and flag issues early
  • Review your final models with the team, updating any details that are needed.

Essential

What We're Looking For

  • Advanced AutoCAD and 3dsMax proficiency.

jobs.title: Safety Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About SkyWest

With over 16,000 aviation professionals operating thousands of daily flights, SkyWest Airlines connects millions of passengers each month to hundreds of destinations across North America. SkyWest operates in partnership with Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, American Airlines, and Alaska Airlines and has a fleet of nearly 450 aircraft. Headquartered in St. George, Utah, SkyWest's industry-leading workforce and excellent leadership team have consistently generated solid operational and economic performance, setting the standard for excellence in the regional industry.

SkyWest employees enjoy a distinctive and unmatched culture of teamwork, respect, quality, and professionalism, along with world-class benefits such as a 401(k) match, Performance Rewards, health care, retirement, and discounted travel worldwide.

Primary Job Duties

  • Analyze, compile, and report safety data to support all SkyWest safety programs.
  • Collect, analyze, and report safety assurance data from multiple safety data sources.
  • Identify, monitor, and communicate safety performance trends and emerging risks.
  • Track, maintain, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Safety Department, including Flight Severity Index (FSI) events.
  • Present data analysis findings in safety meetings, investigations, and Safety Risk Assessments (SRAs).
  • Provide safety data reports and analysis for:
  • Partner safety metric reporting
  • Internal and external safety meetings
  • Pattern and trend analysis for Department Safety Managers and Safety Committees
  • Ad hoc reporting supporting investigations and proactive risk assessments
  • Maintain process measurement data and performance metrics for Safety Managers.
  • Create, update, and maintain Tableau dashboards and other reporting tools to support safety initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision-making through proactive analysis of safety risks and operational trends.
  • Recognize and report hazards in the work environment through established safety reporting programs.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of safety data and reports.

Compensation: The salary range for this position is $37,000-$52,000 per year. Initial offers will be based on a combination of relevant work experience, education, certifications, and formal training.

Minimum Requirements

  • Qualified through education, training, experience, and expertise to perform data analysis functions.
  • Formal education in data analytics, statistics, quantitative methods, data collection, data interpretation, and analytical techniques; and/or a professional data analyst certification.
  • Two years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a related analytical role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex data findings to leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize competing deadlines.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel and experienced with the Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Tableau, including dashboard development and maintenance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with aviation safety assurance programs, such as ASAP, FOQA, and LOSA.
  • Experience with Excellence through Quality (EtQ) Reliance software.
  • Experience working within an Aviation Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Knowledge of Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) and company policies and procedures.
  • Experience analyzing operational, safety, or risk-management data.
  • Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets to identify trends, risks, and performance indicators.

Physical And Other Requirements

  • Open to remote work or based in SGU or SLC.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Ability to travel occasionally as required.
  • This is not a Department of Transportation safety-sensitive position.

jobs.title: Paralegal
jobs.description:
Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What Youâll Do

As Paralegal, youâll take full ownership of the NDA & intake process. Youâll drive NDAs to execution independently, without attorneys needing to be involved. Youâll maintain a centralized legal intake process â a single place where requests come in, get triaged, and get worked â and then hold the rest of the company accountable to using it. Youâll own the signature pipeline end to end: queuing documents, sending them out, and tracking them to completion. This is a highly autonomous role: youâll be given the outcome we need and trusted to enforce the process to get there, adapting as priorities shift.

This role starts as an individual contributor with real scope across every project at Giga, and thereâs a clear path to take on bigger, more complex work as you prove out the process.

Where youâll work

This role is remote. Travel is light â expect roughly 0â10%, mainly for occasional in-person team time.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end NDA process â draft, negotiate, and drive NDAs to execution independently, escalating to attorneys only on true edge cases.
  • Design and own a centralized legal intake process, replacing todayâs scattered mix of personal email, Slack channels and DMs, and texts with a single, clear front door for legal requests.
  • Triage incoming legal requests â route them appropriately and set expectations on turnaround.
  • Enforce the intake process company-wide: when requests bypass it, redirect requesters back into the right workflow, including on Daveâs behalf.
  • Manage the full signature pipeline â queue documents, send for e-signature, and track them to completion.
  • Maintain and organize the contract repository so agreements are easy to find, track, and report on.
  • Partner with attorneys and business teams to keep the legal function organized and responsive as request volume grows.
  • Take on larger, higher-complexity projects as you build trust and track record in the role.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience as a paralegal or in a similar legal operations role.
  • Experience independently managing NDAs from drafting through execution.
  • Experience building, running, or significantly improving a legal intake or triage process.
  • Working knowledge of e-signature tools, contract repositories, and contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools.
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal oversight, exercising sound judgment on when to escalate to attorneys.
  • Comfortable enforcing process consistently while staying flexible as priorities and workflows shift.

Bonus points

  • Paralegal certificate.
  • 10+ years of experience in a legal operations or paralegal role.
  • Experience standing up legal intake or operations processes from scratch.
  • Experience supporting legal teams at a high-growth or fast-paced company.
  • Experience preparing legal notes or executive briefs.

Benefits

  • Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Equity (options) in a rapidly growing startup
  • 401(k) with 4% employer match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Parental leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits
  • Monthly team on-sites where all offices come in-person to collaborate

Who We Hire

We hire people who thrive in chaos and get sharper under pressure. You don't wait to be told what to do, you spot the gap and fill it. When there's work to be done, you do it. You make decisions with the information you have, move fast, and adjust along the way. We're not looking for perfect; we're looking for people who get things done.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Compensation: $160kâ190k base + meaningful equity

About Flint

The best education anyone has ever received is one person paying close attention to one student: moving at their pace, noticing what they missed, asking the next question at the right moment. But the current system is built around a compromise with one teacher managing thirty students.

Flint exists to take that compromise off the table. Personalized learning, at the scale of a whole school â every student working with something closer to a tutor, and every teacher able to see what's actually happening across their class instead of guessing.

Go look at the product before you read any further: app.flintk12.com

The Role

Students want something that stays with them, going at their pace and helps them get unstuck without just handing over the answer. Teachers want that happening inside a class they still control, and they'd like their evenings back. Admins want proof that the platform they rolled out is leading to teacher productivity and student progress.

Your job is to dive deep into this design problem, holding three sets of needs within one product. Weâll trust you to ship designs that are the best possible solution to our users most urgent pain points. tl;dr you'll get to own how Flint works and how it feels.

How We Work

  • We move fast, and closely. You'll work with a small, senior team: one Product Lead, a Chief of Staff (Product), a CTO, and five engineers. We also have a running joke that we canât keep up with our #product_updates channel because of how much we ship.
  • Fast and good aren't in tension here. In our experience the fastest route to something good is getting a rough version in front of a real teacher early, which tends to be quicker than getting it right in private. Decisions with the highest impact have often happened within days, not month long sprints.
  • Weâre always learning. Call it on-brand or a bit on the nose, but learning from each other, our customers, the market have been key to our growth. We even have channels dedicated to sharing our workflow mistakes and wins. Education is also still being actively shaped as a field, and staying tuned to what users and the industry are telling us matters more than assuming we already know.
  • Users drive our decisions. Our team isn't exclusively made up of former teachers, and that's deliberate. We'd rather build from real user feedback and a range of perspectives than from any one person's classroom experience. Our close connection with teachers, students, and admins helps us quickly understand what's working and what isn't.
  • We design with AI, not around it. Lo-fi concepts out of Claude, prototypes we can put in front of a teacher the same week, PRDs drafted from screenshots and voice notes: these are just a few ways weâve used AI to support our work, and it's a real part of why our loop is as short as it is.

What You'll Do

  • Dig deep, validate, and design. Validate the user goals, map key journeys, and land on the actual jobs to be done. People will hand you solutions along the way: the useful move is usually to find the need underneath before taking the solution at face value.
  • Explore broadly, then narrow. Iteration is key. For a complex UI, we'd expect five or six real concepts on the table before committing to one, whether it sketches, wireframes, AI-generated lo-fi, competitor and industry researchâ¦whatever gets you there fastest. Then you cut it down with your own judgment, a review with someone on the team, and wherever we can manage it, real users.
  • Design zero to one, and one to a hundred. Some of this is a genuinely new problem where you shape the whole thing from scratch. Some of it is taking something we shipped early and making it scalable, coherent, and delightful in the way the first version never had time to be.
  • Communicate your judgment effectively. You can clearly explain the context, intent, designs, and the reasoning behind your work to the rest of the team.
  • Set the design bar. Our design system and design philosophy are still taking form. You'll decide what becomes a pattern, what stays a one-off, and where the whole thing goes from here.
  • Stay through QA and impact. You'll have a say in what gets QA'd and in what metrics tell us whether the thing actually worked. Shipping isn't the end of your involvement.
  • Impact hundreds of thousands of learners. How a generation learns to think alongside AI is being decided right now, in the products that get built this year. Very few designers get to work on something this consequential this early.

What We're Looking For

  • You've designed and shipped real software. We care far more about one thing you made and can talk us through than about ten polished case-study slides.
  • You can run the whole arc, from understanding the problem through concepts, hi-fi, and a spec engineering can build from. Not every step has to be your strongest.
  • You're comfortable with being scrappy and being iterative. You'd rather put a rough thing in front of a real teacher than a perfect thing in front of your own team.
  • You want to shape a category-defining product. You're excited by building something that hasn't existed before and genuinely changes how people learn â not iterating on the margins of something that already works.
  • You're here to learn, not just to apply what you already know. That means sharpening your design skills and process on the job, and getting deep on the education industry itself, from US private Kâ12 to foreign education ministries and everything in between. You find that range interesting rather than intimidating.
  • You care about education. You should like what you are building and who you are building for!

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Personal device stipend.

How to Apply

Message Sun with your resume and portfolio, or apply here.

e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin. Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. We are the #2 mass cosmetics brand in the US and are the fastest growing mass cosmetics brand among the top 5. The Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhodeâs growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.

\n


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Provide weekly sell in data vs. forecast and any risks associated to the month/quarter plan to Finance, Sales and Operations stakeholders

  • Track & monitor weekly sell out data coupled with retailer in stock levels in partnership with Demand planning and Sales account leads

  • Track and report on key international customer supply chain KPIs, including fulfillment, in-stocks, service levels, on-time delivery, and potential chargeback risk

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and contribute to customer demand forecasting, maximizing forecast accuracy

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

  • Partner closely with international teams, distributors, and cross-functional stakeholders to support new market launches, regional assortment expansion, and ongoing operational excellence.

  • Ability to connect internal functions to drive supply chain improvements (fill rate, on-time, in-stocks, reduce potential chargebacks, customer program execution) for the customer

  • Help educate and align internal teams on international customer expectations, distributor requirements, regional retailer requirements, and best practices for execution

  • Experience managing multiple countries, distributors, or regional supply chain requirements 

  • Willingness to travel internationally is required

Description du poste Job Description:***Un poste de *Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f)* est à pourvoir au sein de l'organisation Ventes et Marketing d'Airbus Defence and Space. En tant que Responsable Commercial et Contrats (h/f), vous serez le point focal commercial et contractuel pour les autres départements et fonctions impliqués dans la préparation de l'offre puis, dans l'exécution du projet. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe Core Team avec le Campaign Manager, le Bid Manager, le Program manager, l'acheteur ou l'engineering, et la Finance.

Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir en Europe. e ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.***Compétences requises***De formation ingénieur, juridique ou commercial, vous avez ensuite développé une connaissance et expérience en appel d'offre et en négociation commerciale et contractuelle.


Vous avez les compétences et l'expérience suivantes Au moins* 5 ans* d'expérience dans le montage de propositions commerciales et contractuelles (la connaissance des règles des marchés publics/gouvernementaux - DGA française est un plus)***Connaissance accrue d'Excel, Word et PowerPoint***Autonomie et capacité de synthèse et d'analyse***Esprit d'équipe, communication et capacité de convaincre Vous avez l'habitude des négociations (tant au sein d'Airbus qu'avec les clients), en français mais également en *anglais***Un CV en anglais et un CV en français est demandé.***A Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) position is available within the Sales and Marketing organization of Airbus Defence and Space. The position will be based in Elancourt.


The Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f) will be responsible for providing commercial and legal expertise during the BID phase, contract execution, and until contract closure.


As a Commercial and Contracts Manager (m/f), you will be the commercial and contractual focal point for other departments and functions involved in the preparation of the offer and then in the project execution. You will be part of the Core Team with the Campaign Manager, the Bid Manager, the Program Manager, the buyer or engineering, and Finance.


This position will require a French security clearance or will require eligibility for clearance by recognized authorities.***Tasks and Responsibilities***Your main tasks and responsibilities will be as follows:***Offer and Proposal Negotiation***Work closely with internal stakeholders (legal, compliance, finance, center of expertise, export control, etc provide profitable commercial solutions Evaluate commercial, financial, contractual, compliance, and export control risk***find alternatives to minimize them***Propose and negotiate contractual amendments always with the aim of improving the performance of our projects and limiting risks***Prepare documentation related to the commercial and legal aspects of the offer Ensure consistency with Airbus Defence and Space directives***Responsible for negotiating the commercial aspects of the proposal with customers Support the development of new opportunities and new services.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Finance Business Partner to join Notion’s Strategic Finance team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with leaders across Finance, People, Legal, and other business functions to drive financial insights, improve planning processes, and provide strategic analyses to enable the company to scale thoughtfully. The ideal candidate brings deep FP&A expertise and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with executive leaders and functional leaders to drive critical business decisions. Build trusted relationships and proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities.

 - Build and own financial models, including capacity and benefits modeling. Prepare strategic trade-off analyses that help leadership prioritize investments so Notion scales responsibly.

 - Partner with Corporate Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional teams to deliver monthly and quarterly reporting and forecasting. Ensure accurate, timely reporting, providing clear variance explanations, and translating results into actionable recommendations for executives and functional leaders.

 - Identify and implement AI and automation-driven improvements that allow financial processes to scale, drive real-time reporting, and enable impactful analyses.

 - Deliver thoughtful ad hoc analyses for executive and business partner with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience leveraging AI in financial workflows. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance in the technology industry; or in accounting, investment banking, consulting, treasury, or private equity

 - Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, budget vs. actuals, annual planning, and long-range planning

 - Comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership and building cross-functional relationships

 - Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to continually up-level current approaches and processes

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with a high-growth tech company, including native AI, SaaS, or consumption-based businesses

 - Experience with NetSuite, Workday, Zip, and planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan)

 - Working knowledge of SQL

jobs.title: Pracownik socjalny (K/M)
jobs.employer: Powiatowe Centrum Pomocy Rodzinie w Siedlcach
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Praca socjalna, przeprowadzanie rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych. Pomoc cudzoziemcom, którzy uzyskali w Rzeczpospolitej Polskiej status uchodźcy, ochronę uzupełniającą lub zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy udzielone w związku z okolicznością. októrej mowa w art. 159 ust.1 pkt 1 lit. C lub ustawy z dnia 12 grudnia 2013 r. o cudzoziemcach, mających trudności w integracji ze środowiskiem. Umieszczanie w domach pomocy społecznej o zasięgu ponadgminnym skierowanych do nich osób, koordynacja, prowadzenie dokumentacji i przygotowywanie decyzji w sprawie umieszczenia osób w domach pomocy społecznej. Prowadzenie sprawozdawczości. Realizacja zadań związanych z funkcjonowaniem mieszkań chronionych oraz powiatowych ośrodków wsparcia, w tym domów dla samotnych matek z małoletnimi dziećmi i kobiet w ciąży. Realizacja zadań wynikających z rządowych programów pomocy społecznej, mających na celu ochronę poziomu życia osób, rodzin i grup społecznych oraz rozwój specjalistycznego wsparcia.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- umiejętności: prawo jazdy kat. B - konieczne
- pozostałe: wykształcenie niezbędne do wykonywania zawodu pracownika socjalnego zgodnie z art. 116 ust.1 oraz art. 156 ustawy o pomocy społecznej tj.: ukończyła studia na kierunku praca socjalna lub w zakresie pracy socjalnej, do dnia 31 grudnia 2013 r. ukończyła studia wyższe o specjalności przygotowującej do zawodu pracownika socjalnego na jednym z kierunków: pedagogika, pedagogika specjalna, politologia, polityka społeczna, psychologia, socjologia, nauki o rodzinie, ukończone studia podyplomowe z zakresu metodyki i metodologii pracy socjalnej w uczelni realizującej studia na kierunku praca socjalna lub w zakresie pracy socjalnej, po uprzednim ukończeniu studiów na jednym z kierunków, o których mowa w pkt c., pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych oraz korzystanie z pełni praw publicznych, niekaralność za przestępstwo ścigane z oskarzenia publicznego popełnione umyślnie oraz za przestępstwa skarbowe, nie figuruje

jobs.title: Senior Adviser - Asset Management & Alternative Investment Transformation - Consulting (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: KPMG Tax and Advisory S.à r.l.
jobs.description:
Senior Adviser - Asset Management & Alternative Investment Transformation - Consulting (m/f/d)

Job Description
Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.
We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.
We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Adviser for our Consulting practice in Asset Management & Alternative Investments
We are looking for an experienced consultant to join our established and growing Management & Regulatory Consulting practice as an Senior Adviser. In this role, you will work on large-scale transformation projects within the Asset Management industry, with a specialized focus on Alternative Investments and Tech enabled projects. Our clients include leading banks, asset service providers, and asset managers across Luxembourg and Europe.

What you will be working on

1. Client Advisory and Project Oversight

Lead Transformation Projects
Spearhead large-scale projects in Asset Management, emphasizing Alternative Investments and technology-driven solutions.
Cultivate Client Relationships
Act as a trusted advisor, aligning our consulting services with client objectives and ensuring timely delivery on project milestones.

2. Team Leadership and Knowledge Sharing

Collaborate Across Disciplines
Partner with KPMG experts across various sectors to develop multi-faceted solutions that meet comprehensive client needs.
Mentor Future Leaders
Guide and support junior team members, fostering their professional growth by sharing industry insights and best practices.

3. Market and Business Development

Stay Ahead on Industry Trends

Conduct ongoing research into evolving trends in Alternative Investments and regulatory frameworks to keep our clients informed and competitive.

Drive New Business Opportunities

Engage in proposal preparation and networking efforts to expand our client base and enhance our consulting reach.

What we look for
