Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.
Your role will include:
• Lead the research, development and innovation (RDI) activities on the Frugal AI topic, defining and shaping research directions in line with LIST's strategic objectives.
• Drive the development of innovative Frugal AI technologies and methodologies.
• Develop and manage RDI project proposals, ensuring alignment with strategic research objectives at the group and unit level. Identify funding and grant opportunities; prepare and submit proposals to secure financial support for RDI activities.
• Oversee the execution of RDI projects with external partners, ensuring that they meet their objectives, timelines and budgets.
•  Align with ongoing standards around Frugal AI and Green AI and explore opportunities and collaborations with the consortia behind those standards.
• Establish and maintain collaborations with industrial partners, public organisations, research institutes and universities to enhance research impact and technology transfer.
• Actively participate in EU and (inter)national consortia and contribute to collaborative research projects.
• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:
• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.
• Use of AI to improve sustainability aspects of AI and non-AI systems based on an analysis of their current architecture and operational data.
• Machine learning and neural network architectures, including convolutional, recurrent and transformer networks.
• MLOps and model management to streamline ML development.
• Multimodal input and how multimodality impacts frugality.
• Data management, data valorisation and data processing techniques, including data sandboxes, data spaces, data synthesis and data augmentation.
• AI evaluation, assessment, testing and benchmarking, including AI sandbox.
• Knowledge of the latest trends and developments in AI, with the ability to apply these advances to practical, real-world challenges.
• Experience working with business domain experts to apply the above AI innovation capabilities in at least one vertical domain in the private and/or public sector, such as finance, space, cybersecurity, energy, mobility and logistics, defence, manufacturing, education, health, central or local government, etc.
• Sustainable practices and global initiatives in the area (UNESCO sustainable development goals, digital product passport initiatives, product circularity data sheets…) that may have influence in the evolution and growing interest in Frugal AI.
• Software engineering and, in particular, low-code technologies. This includes some knowledge of low-code and no-code AI approaches.

In addition, we would appreciate proven experience in the following soft skills:
• Passion for AI research and technology with a relentless drive for innovation.
• Proven experience in leading and managing RDI projects in AI/ML with a track record of successful project delivery and innovation.
• Experience of building and maintaining collaborative networks with academic, industrial and research partners, with excellent networking skills.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-expert audiences.
• Experience in organising workshops, seminars and conferences to disseminate research findings and promote community engagement.
• Ability to identify emerging research areas and technology trends and set the direction for future research efforts and technological advances.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

Language skills

Your LIST benefits

jobs.description:
Sales Structurer - CIB Financial Markets (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1132

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

• Act as a financial markets expert and assist own issued and manufactured products (structured notes, overlays, warrants, vanilla rates products etc.) by providing pricing, idea generation, structuring, product development and information for the various internal and external clients serviced by the department, which span from large institutional investors and financial institutions (including securities firms, asset managers, brokers etc.), to individual wealth management and retail clients.
• Assist structuring and pricings cross different asset classes (rates, equity, commodities, credit etc.) BIL structured notes, warrants and OTC derivatives both for clients who are custodised with the Bank but also clients on a brokerage base model where products are settled externally. To play current market themes, or tailormade solutions to suit the dedicated objectives of clients, where ideas are in line with client`s objectives, policy of the Bank or short-term opportunities arising in the market.
• Help the senior specialist develop product concepts, create pricing, performance and scenario models, seek product approvals where required, and perform product analysis, including scenario analysis and performance simulations (historical and forward looking).
• Create presentations and factsheets to present sophisticated structured investment ideas, concepts, strategies, products and solutions (including structured products, warrants, as well as hedging, overlay and derivatives strategies), for different types of investors /clients (both external and internal), as well as other stakeholders.
• Support under the supervision of senior Structuring & Sales employees the issuance process for new structured notes and other securitized instruments as well as (when occurring) off balance sheet investment instruments (repacks, securitizations etc.), from pricing, structuring and idea generation, to trading, execution and hedging, as well as booking the products and support the documentation creation.
• Draft documentation for Structured Products, including the Term sheets, Final Terms, Pricing Supplements and Key Information Documents.
• Assist projects that support the development of the Bank's own product gamma, especially structured products business, from the development of tools and platforms to enhancements of the Bank's infrastructure and systems.

Your skills:

• Master degree, preferably in Finance, Economics, Mathematics or another quantitative based subject
• Fluent in English provided that this is the language of the financial markets industry. French and / or German would be beneficial.
• Good understanding of Financial Markets, products and services across asset classes.
• Good foundation of theoretical knowledge in regard to financial markets products and specifically derivatives.
• Experience in Private Banking is considered a plus.

• A good communicator, with commercial awareness and the ability to bring over the message to the internal and external client base, as well as within the supporting units of the organisation
• Skilled at generating, marketing and presenting complex investment ideas and solutions to a wide range of audiences.

• Affinity with the marketing, compliance, legal, risk and operational frameworks and processes relating to the financial markets business.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

In this role, you will guide clients through our structured onboarding process, ensuring they adopt INNERGY effectively and achieve measurable business value early in their journey.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients by setting clear expectations, defining milestones, and tracking progress against onboarding goals.
  • Education & Enablement: Support client education by integrating learning opportunities into onboarding and collaborating with the Content Creation team to prioritize and request the training resources clients need most.
  • Process Monitoring: Use data and progress tracking to monitor client health during onboarding, identifying and addressing potential challenges early.
  • Client Motivation: Keep clients engaged and motivated throughout onboarding, encouraging adoption of INNERGY processes and best practices.
  • Communication: Maintain clear, consistent communication with clients, providing regular updates and documenting all interactions for cross-team visibility.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and address challenges such as limited client engagement or resistance to change. Develop strategies to overcome these obstacles and keep onboarding on track.
  • Feedback Loop: Gather client feedback throughout onboarding and share insights to help refine onboarding strategies and influence future training content priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in onboarding, client success, or related roles, preferably within Microvellum architectural millwork industry, or manufacturing.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights to manage progress and risks.
  • Skilled at motivating and guiding clients toward successful outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with content or training teams to prioritize and influence resource development.
  • Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to client needs and challenges.
  • Travel up to 10%

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

jobs.title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
jobs.description:
Description

Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney

Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU)

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Who We Are

The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law.

Role Description

The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects.

How You Will Make a Difference

Case Support

  • Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email.
  • Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics.
  • Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members.
  • Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping.
  • Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases.
  • Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery.
  • Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases.
  • Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed.
  • Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation.
  • Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities.
  • Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support.
  • Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit.

External Relationship Building and Outreach

  • Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine.
  • Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies.

Internal Relationship Building

  • Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs.
  • Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials.
  • Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering.

Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission.

Requirements

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

  • A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of.
  • At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management.
  • Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification).
  • The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment.
  • Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics.
  • The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress.
  • An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund.
  • The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year.

We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including

  • Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036.

To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. Rate is determined by role, using set geographical factors.

  • Comprehensive health care, dental, life and vision benefits (100% employer paid); Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA) are also available
  • 192 hours of PTO
  • 19 paid holidays
  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of continuous employment
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with a maximum 5% employer contribution match after one year of employment
  • Alternative work schedules (at managerâs discretion)
  • One-time remote work allowance of $750
  • Annual professional development reimbursement of up to $1,000.

Maintaining a healthy work/life balance is a core value for the Animal Legal Defense Fund.

Additional Information

This role is included in a collective bargaining unit that is represented by the Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU). Certain terms and conditions of your employment, including wages and benefits, have been negotiated with the Union and are included in a collective bargaining agreement between ALDF and the Union.

This is a U.S. based position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

The Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing an employment environment which is welcoming of persons from diverse backgrounds and free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and in which all legal rights of our employees are recognized and protected. ALDF conducts all internal and external operations, programs, and employment-related decision making (including hiring decisions) without regard to actual or perceived race, ancestry, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, political affiliation, disability or medical condition (including physical, intellectual, or psychiatric), sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, age, or other protected category, and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination and anti-harassment laws.

Consistent with the organizationâs mission, our offices and events are free of animal products and byproducts.

jobs.title: Team Member
jobs.description:
Hiring a new team member is a big deal-especially when you're searching for someone who can bring humor, energy, and reliability into the workplace. We're not just looking for any team member; we want someone outgoing enough to make Mondays feel slightly less like Mondays. A team member who walks in with a smile strong enough to power half the office lights. A team member who is friendly, hardworking, and observant enough to notice when the coffee machine is plotting against us again.

The ideal team member should be the type of person who says "good morning" even before the caffeine kicks in. A team member who can juggle tasks, conversations, and maybe even office snacks without dropping the ball. A team member who brings good vibes but also gets the job done with focus and dedication. We want a team member who knows when to joke around and when to buckle down. A team member whose presence makes the team stronger, happier, and a little more human. And finally, a team member who knows that teamwork makes the dream work-even when the printer refuses to cooperate.

If that sounds like you, congratulations-you might just be our perfect team member.

jobs.title: Julgestustöötaja-tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: öösiti

jobs.title: Servant of the restaurant
jobs.description:
Seasonal work during the summer period

Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 0.25 - 0.75

jobs.title: Project manager
jobs.description:
Specialized in international CBD

Work tasks: - Develop and implement the company’s overall business strategy and annual operational plans, ensuring alignment with long‑term development objectives and the cross‑border business focus between Asia (including China) and European countries, including Estonia.
- Oversee the company’s daily operations in Estonia, covering financial management, compliance governance, and cooperation within an international team. - Lead business expansion, partner negotiations, and project execution in the Estonian and European markets, while ensuring continuous collaboration with Chinese stakeholders and supply chains. - Represent the company in external communications with Estonian government authorities, industry associations, and business partners. - Prepare the annual budget and investment plans and monitor the achievement of financial indicators and business targets. - Manage global intellectual property registration, protection, and commercialization (e.g., patent registration and licensing in Asia and the European Union; global business expansion in the fields of product development, manufacturing, and sales for medical device factories and pharmaceutical manufacturers).

We offer: - Support for professional training and industry development activities;
- Official business and work-related expense reimbursement. - Online and remote work is allowed with the management’s awareness and written consent. - The employment contract is valid for one year. Two to three months before each expiration date, the employer will discuss renewing the contract for another year with the employee based on actual business needs; renewal is only possible upon mutual agreement.

Other requirements: A bachelor’s degree in law, pharmacy, or medicine is required. Candidates who have published research articles related to the company’s core business direction in nationally authoritative academic journals in the fields of pharmaceuticals and medicine are preferred. Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is a significant advantage, as the role requires frequent and substantive cooperation with suppliers and market teams in Asian Hong Kong and Mainland China.

Option to work from home: Yes

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

jobs.title: Tech Operations Specialist

Merchandising Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

Merchandising Operations Manager

Grove's merchandising operation is full of good instincts running on manual work. This role exists to fix that: redesign the core processes, then personally build the automation that makes them stick. This is a rare shot at rebuilding how merchandising actually runs, and at proving AI belongs in the hands of the person closest to the problem, not just the AI team.

We're not hiring someone to write a strategy memo about AI and hand it off. We're hiring someone who will map the workflow, feel where it breaks, and then sit down and build the thing that fixes it.

More About the Opportunity

  • Merchandising at Grove runs on real expertise and too much manual glue.
  • Buyers chase vendors for the same data, week after week.
  • Marketing launches promotions inventory finds out about too late.
  • Good people spend their time on work a workflow should be doing for them.
  • We have an internal AI team. They coach. They don't build for you.
  • This role is for the person who wants their hands on the keyboard, not the person who scopes it and waits.
  • The honest version: no template here. You're defining the standard as you go, with review at key milestones and real autonomy in between.
  • Some of what you build will work on the first try. Some won't. That's the job.

What You'll Own

  • Map how merchandising actually works today, not how the org chart says it works.
  • Redesign core operating processes for speed, accuracy, and margin protection: assortment planning, item setup, pricing and markdown, vendor and PO management, allocation, replenishment.
  • Own the calendar connecting marketing activations to inventory, so launches are stock-backed, not a surprise to the warehouse.
  • Translate activation plans into buy, allocation, and replenishment signals; flag stock risk before launch, not after.
  • Coordinate vendor commitments tied to activations: fill rates, lead times, launch quantities.
  • Build self-service tools and proactive alerts that scale the buyer-vendor relationship, including visibility into vendor performance.
  • Build the automation yourself, using Claude and comparable AI tools, no/low-code platforms, and lightweight automation, from concept through rollout.
  • Run pilots end to end: scope, build, test for accuracy, validate fit, scale. Keep humans in the loop on margin- and inventory-critical decisions.
  • Maintain a registry of approved tools and active automations, so what exists and what it's for is never a mystery.
  • Own change management for every rollout: training, AI literacy for non-technical audiences, office hours, a bench of power users.
  • Build reporting on process and automation performance, and use it to prioritize what gets built next.

About You

  • Real fluency in retail merchandising operations, not an adjacent function you've watched from a distance.
  • You've mapped a broken process and redesigned it, not just diagnosed it.
  • Basic technical acumen and a genuine willingness to build, no engineering background required.
  • Comfortable working with a specialist team as a coaching resource, not a build team, and taking their guidance without handing off your job.
  • You've run a pilot from scoping through adoption, and you know the gap between a demo and something people actually use.
  • You care about the boring, durable stuff: documentation, SOPs, registries, training, the things that outlast the person who built them.
  • You think in workflows and root causes, not tickets.
  • You know the difference between a problem worth automating and one worth leaving alone.

Even Better if You Have

  • Built something with Claude or a comparable AI tool that a non-technical team now relies on.
  • Experience connecting marketing or demand planning to inventory and allocation.
  • Designed a self-service tool that measurably cut manual buyer-vendor back-and-forth.
  • A retail, CPG, or commerce background with real fluency in vendor and marketplace dynamics.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

Assessment

The exam must be completed within a specified timeframe, but you may do so at your convenience.

Jag deltar gärna i vissa av DUV:s fritidsaktiviteter och uppskattar också möjligheten att ibland göra en utflykt under veckosluten. jobs.title: Myyjiä henkilöstöpooliin Koillismaan osuuskauppaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUUSAMO

Haemme myyjiä Koillismaan osuuskaupan henkilöstöpooliin eli Savottatiimiin

Savotalla kukaan ei pärjää yksin – parhaat tulokset syntyvät yhteistyöllä. Siksi savottalaisen sydän ohjaa meidän arkeamme täällä Koillismaalla: autamme toisiamme yli toimipaikkarajojen, tartumme rohkeasti toimeen ja huolehdimme siitä, että niin työkaverit kuin asiakkaatkin voivat luottaa siihen, että apua löytyy silloin, kun sitä tarvitaan. Tätä tarvetta varten rakennamme Savottatiimin – henkilöstöpoolin, jonka jäsenet varmistavat, että apu on lähellä.

Haemme joukkoomme rohkeita tekijöitä – Savottalaisia – jotka ovat valmiita tekemään aidosti merkityksellistä työtä useissa oman savotta-alueensa toimipaikoissa. Toimipaikkoja ovat osuuskauppamme Salet, S-marketit, Prisma ja ABC:t. Savottatiimi toimii kolmella alueella: Itälapin alue (Kemijärvi – Salla – Savukoski), Ruka-Kuusamon alue ja Taivalkoski – Posion alue. Työ edellyttää mahdollisuutta liikkua oman savotta-alueesi toimipaikkojen välillä omalla autolla tai muulla luotettavalla kulkutavalla. Työsopimuksen viikkotyöaika on 10–25 tuntia, ja työvuorot suunnitellaan työvoimatarpeen mukaan. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan elo–syyskuun aikana. Sopimus on määräaikainen.
Savottalaisena yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen. yhtenä päivänä voit aloittaa työvuorosi Prismassa hyllytyksen ja asiakaspalvelun parissa, seuraavalla viikolla olla tukemassa Salea sesonkikiireessä ja kuukauden päästä auttaa ABC:llä ruuhkahuipun aikana.

Mitä Savottalaisen työ on?
Savottalaisena työskentelet siellä, missä osaamistasi juuri sillä hetkellä tarvitaan. Työpäiväsi voivat sijoittua alueesi eri toimipaikkoihin esimerkiksi:
äkillisten sairauspoissaolojen tueksi
vuosilomien sijaisuuksiin
sesonkien kiireisiin
uusien tiimien ja toimipaikkojen vahvistukseksi
Jokainen savottavuoro on mahdollisuus auttaa työyhteisöä onnistumaan ja varmistaa, että asiakkaamme saavat aina parasta mahdollista palvelua. Työvuorot suunnitellaan pääosin etukäteen, mutta osa vuoroista voi tulla tarjolle myös lyhyemmällä varoitusajalla esimerkiksi äkillisten poissaolojen vuoksi.

Kenelle työ sopii?
Sinulle, joka:
nautit vaihtelevista työpäivistä
innostut uusista ihmisistä ja työyhteisöistä
opit nopeasti uusia toimintatapoja
toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja joustavasti
haluat kehittyä moniosaajaksi
olet valmis liikkumaan savotta-alueesi toimipaikkojen välillä
Aikaisempi kokemus kaupan alalta on eduksi, mutta perehdytämme tehtävään huolellisesti. Saat perehdytyksen niihin toimipaikkoihin ja työtehtäviin, joissa työskentelet.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
monipuolisen työn eri toimipaikoissa
kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen
mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi laajasti
S-ryhmän erinomaiset henkilöstöedut Erinomaiset edut – Koillismaa
Kaupan TES:n mukainen myyjän palkkaus ja mahdollisuus tulospalkkioon

Miksi Savottatiimi?
Savottatiimissä et työskentele vain yhdessä toimipaikassa – pääset tutustumaan koko osuuskauppaamme ja rakentamaan laajan verkoston eri työyhteisöissä.
Savottatiimi pitää arjen liikkeessä. Savottalaiset menevät sinne, missä heidän osaamisellaan on juuri sillä hetkellä suurin merkitys, ja varmistavat, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta palvelua myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.
Savottalaisena toimit eri toimipaikoissa, tutustut uusiin työyhteisöihin ja pääset jakamaan omaa osaamistasi samalla, kun kartutat kokemusta erilaisista työympäristöistä. Työ tarjoaa vaihtelua, jatkuvaa oppimista ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti.
Savottatiimissä työskentely avaa myös uusia näkökulmia organisaatioomme ja voi tarjota arvokkaita kokemuksia sekä uusia uramahdollisuuksia oman osuuskauppamme sisällä.
Savottatiimissä et jää yksin – jokaisessa toimipaikassa sinut otetaan vastaan osaksi työyhteisöä, ja tukenasi ovat sekä esihenkilöt että kollegat.

Oletko sinä seuraava Savottalainen?
Jos nautit vaihtelusta, haluat oppia uutta ja tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä, Savottatiimi voi olla juuri sinun paikkasi. Hae mukaan tekemään yhdessä sujuvaa arkea – yksi savottavuoro kerrallaan.
Haku on auki 23.8.2026 asti. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa henkilöstöpäällikkö Jonna Manninen, p. 010 76 33007 arkisin klo 9-15 välillä tai sähköpostitse jonna.1.manninen@sok.fi

Koillismaan Osuuskauppa on perustettu 1907 ja toimimme Koillismaalla ja Itä-Lapissa seitsemän kunnan alueella Kuusamossa, Taivalkoskella, Posiolla, Sallassa, Savukoskella, Kemijärvellä ja Pelkosenniemellä. Koillismaan Osuuskaupan omistaa reilut 14 600 Koillismaalaista ja osuuskaupassamme on töissä noin 300 työntekijää. Olemme savuton työnantaja.
Teemme Koillismaasta luonnostaan parempaa paikka elää ja asiakkaidemme arjesta juhlaa. Tuloksemme ohjataan oman toimialueen investointeihin, asiakasomistajiemme palkitsemiseen, henkilöstömme ammattitaidosta ja työhyvinvoinnista huolehtimiseen, yhteiskunnallisten vastuiden kantamiseen sekä monimuotoisen harrastus- ja yleishyödyllisen toiminnan tukemiseen.

jobs.title: Head Baker Wanted – Lead the Rise at Flåm Bakery
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled and passionate baker who loves crafting high-quality baked goods – and ready to take charge of production in a bakery known for its high standards? Would you like to build strong teams and play a key role in further developing our bakeries in Flåm and Lærdal? Then we’d love to hear from you!

Flåm Artisan bakery is looking for an experienced baker to lead the production team.

About us:

Flåm Bakeri opened in 2016 and has been a fantastic success ever since. Last summer, we moved into brand-new, spacious premises on the waterfront in the heart of Flåm. Our second location, Laksen Bakeri & Kafé in Lærdal, has seen similar growth. Together, we offer a wide range of products, including artisan breads, traditional Norwegian sweet buns, and classic international pastries – as well as local juices, sandwiches, pizza, and barista coffee. We also do daily deliveries of bread and pastry products to Myrkdalen Resort, our hotels in Flåm/Aurland and Sognaporten.

As Head of Bakery Production, you will play a central role in ensuring our bakeries deliver top-quality baked goods every day. You’ll be a key partner to Gro, manager at 3 of our venues, and help drive the development of our production processes, product range, and team culture.

Key responsibilities:

  • Plan and organize the daily production of baked goods across our locations to ensure freshness and quality at all times
  • Actively participate in production while maintaining high standards and efficient workflows
  • Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and adapt our product offerings in line with customer preferences and market trends
  • Follow established food safety and hygiene procedures (IK-mat) and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations
  • Support administrative tasks such as shift planning and recruitment
  • Foster a positive and inclusive team culture with a focus on motivation, collaboration, and well-being
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of production routines and product development

    Qualifications:

  • Certificate of apprenticeship (fagbrev) as a baker or equivalent experience in food production
  • Several years of experience from an artisan bakery, with solid knowledge of production techniques and quality control
  • Experience with cake baking is a plus
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead and inspire a team
  • Driver’s license (Class B)
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement

We offer:

An exciting position in an ambitious and dynamic company committed to people and community. You’ll join a proud and passionate team within one of Norway’s leading tourism companies, where we encourage both personal and professional growth. At Norway’s Best, we value diversity and inclusion – it’s reflected in our culture. Our employees are encouraged to ask questions, be themselves, and are seen and respected for who they are.

Some of our employee benefits:

  • Competitive employment terms
  • Pension and insurance schemes through Nordea Liv and Gjensidige
  • Discounts and offers on products and activities from Norway’s Best

Location: Flåm Bakeri
Start date: Autumn 2026, or by agreement


Norway’s best Group AS (NBG) er eit leiande norsk reiselivskonsern, med nokre av Norges mest spektakulære natur- og kulturbaserte reiseopplevingar i vår portefølje. Konsernet har sitt hovudkontor i Flåm, og kontorstader i Myrkdalen, på Voss, i Bergen og Narvik. Vi har ein nasjonal ambisjon og er ein konsolidator i norsk reiseliv. NBG er i front på heilskapleg reisemålsutvikling, og har i dag ei verksemd bygd på våre heilårssatsingar i Flåm, Myrkdalen og Narvik. I over 25 år har vi posisjonert Flåm, med Flåmsbana og Nærøyfjorden, til å bli eit av Norges mest populære reisemål. I pudderparadiset Myrkdalen, med Myrkdalen Fjellandsby, har vi den største skidestinasjonen på Vestlandet. I nord eig vi Narvikfjellet i Narvik og verdens nordlegaste dyrepark Polar Park i Bardu. Selskapet har i tillegg aktivitet i Aurland, Lærdal, Geiranger og Oslo. Selskapet har ein stor kommersiell avdeling som marknadsfører og selger våre eigne og andre aktørar sine attraktive produkt til gjester over heile verda. NBG har ein omsetning på vel 850 MNOK, meir enn 500 heilårs- og deltidsansatte og 2 millionar gjester årleg. Utover vår reisemålssatsing eig NBG-konsernet også det innovative selskapet The Fjords, som tilbyr unike nullutslepps reiseopplevingar på norske fjordar, og 50% av den spektakulære Flåmsbana. NBG er ikkje berre eit reiselivskonsern, vi er også ein samfunnsbyggar som ønsker å skape positive ringverknader og attraktive lokalsamfunn der vi har vår verksemd. Vi ønsker å vere i front på bærekraftig reiselivsutvikling og bidra til ei ansvarleg og framtidsretta reiselivsnæring. Vi gjer vårt yttarste for å redusere vår miljøpåvirkning og støtte opp rundt lokal verdiskaping. Våre ansatte er kjernen i verksemda og vi ønsker å skape eit inkluderande, mangfaldig og likestilt miljø med attraktive arbeidsplassar.

Du får mulighed for at arbejde selvstændigt med dit håndværk, men samtidig blive en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. jobs.title: Senior Analog Design Engineer, ASIC
jobs.description:
We are strengthening ASIC Design Team in Murata Finland. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Analog Design Engineer to join our team in Vantaa, Finland.

Murata Finland is developing leading edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full custom mixed mode ASICs from concept level to volume production including wafer level testing. Murata has flexible remote work policy and way of working can be planned according to your personal needs. The job includes on-site work, and part of it can also be done remotely.

Based on your experience and preferences in this position you have opportunity to focus and develop your skills in one of the following roles:

· ASIC Sr. Design Engineer role focusing on block level design and verification or

· Technical Lead role taking responsibility of a specific ASIC design area including leading a small sub team or

- In analog technical lead role, you will take responsibility for a specific ASIC design area and become an expert on that. You work together with a small group of designers leading their design activities and providing support for them. As a technical lead you will also work closely with ASIC PM, other technical leads and stake holders in ASIC project.


· ASIC Project Manager role leading the work of entire ASIC project.

- After you gain experience on Murata ASIC projects there is a possibility to take also a project manager role.


Your main responsibility areas are:

· ASIC specification and system description

· ASIC design, verification and reporting

- Including modules like bandgap, LDO, PLL, ADC, DAC, different SC-circuits and high voltage circuits


· Characterization specifications and result analysis

· Support for production wafer test and result analysis

To be successful in these roles, these are the expected qualities and skills:

- Technical education (e.g. M.Sc., Ph.D. or D.Sc.) with emphasis on microelectronics

- 5+ years of experience in analog ASIC design

- Understanding and knowhow of the common analog blocks such as: VBG, LDO, amplifiers, ADC, DAC, oscillators, filters etc, Basic understanding of digital signal processing

- Know-how of both continuous and switched capacitor circuits

- Experience of EDA tools and mixed signal design flows

- Proactive, systematic and careful way of working

- Fluent communication in English

- Good communication skills to understand various requirements and communicate with external partners and internal teams

- Innovative mindset and interest in working in an international environment

- In addition to the skills mentioned above, the Tech Lead and PM roles also require task management skills, leadership abilities and experience on a technical lead role.


Our culture is based on our values, which are employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction, and we have agreed together what the values mean in practice. We call this cultural etiquette. According to our cultural etiquette we strengthen employee satisfaction by helping each other, treating each other equally and friendly as well as open discussion culture. We also strengthen customer satisfaction by being proactive and innovative and always thinking what our customer needs. Would this kind of work community suit you?

This is an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology contributing to the advancement of society. We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. With our innovative sensor technology, cars remain in their lanes, peoples hearts keep beating and bridges do not collapse. The combination of our Finnish and Japanese capabilities will enable safe and autonomous driving – in all places.

For more information, please contact the hiring manager Juha Syvänen, tel. +358 40 641 6301 (after 3rd August 2026) or e-mail juha.syvanen@murata.com. Juha is pleased to tell you more about Murata and the job. Please send your application with resume and salary expectations via the link latest on 12th Aug 2026. Our hiring team is on vacation during July so we will start browsing through applications in August. Interviews will be held around calendar weeks 34 and 35. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.title: Driver & Mechanic
jobs.employer: VOI TECHNOLOGY NORWAY AS AVD STAVANGER
jobs.description:
Your mission at Voi 

For the position as a Driver & Mechanic - (Fleet Specialist) you'll have the possibility of working in two different areas, depending on workload and suitability. We have our mechanical team, where you will be responsible for the maintenance and repair of our vehicles. This means keeping our scooters in top shape and provide strong support to our team on the ground. We also have our In field team, where you'll be utilising our vans to perform different tasks in the Stavanger area, making sure our operations runs as efficiently as possible. Here are some exciting tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist:

  • Ensuring the logistics of collecting and providing Voi scooters.⚙️

  • Searching for and collecting damaged scooters. 🛴

  • Battery replacement.🔋

  • Performing quick on-site repairs of the scooters.🔧

  • Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles.🔧

  • Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired. ♻️

  • Assisting with the acceptance, packaging, and provision of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse. 🔍

  • Supporting our on-site team as needed, whether it's identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces, or setting up fallen vehicles.🤝

What you'll need to embark

We're looking for a highly motivated and responsible team player who can handle tasks and solve problems independently. With a proactive approach, you should be skilled in finding innovative solutions and achieving set objectives. In addition, the right candidate should have:

  • A valid drivers license for Norway preferred

  • Fluent english, both verbal and written

  • Previous experience with tools or mechanical practices

  • General familiarity with digital tools and applications

  • Local knowledge of Oslo and experience driving in the city

  • The ability to remain calm in stressful situations (such as difficult parking or traffic)

Job conditions 

  • Working hours: Part time 60% - Rotating shifts

  • Contract type: Fixed term

  • Start date: ASAP

NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in UK, you will receive a phone call from a UK number (+44)

Why Voi?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

  • Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Stavanger.

  • Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal

  • Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution

Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.

Diversity Matters

As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. jobs.description:
Sheet Metal Operator / Programmer (Bending & Punching)

We are looking for an experienced sheet metal operator / programmer to join a modern manufacturing environment specializing in high-quality sheet metal processing. The work is long-term and suitable for a skilled professional, not just short seasonal employment.


About the role

In this position, you will work with sheet metal bending and/or punching production, using both modern automated systems and traditional CNC machinery.

Your main responsibilities include:

* Operating and programming sheet metal bending machines and/or punching machines
* Setting up machines and adjusting parameters based on drawings
* Producing parts according to quality and tolerance requirements
* Working with both small and larger production series
* Ensuring efficient and cost-effective production methods


Machines and technology

You may work with advanced equipment such as:

* Hydraulic press brakes (up to 4200 mm bending length)
* Servo-electric press brakes (up to 3100 mm)
* Automatic panel bender (Salvagnini P4Xe, up to 2180 mm)
* Punching & laser cutting combo machines (Finn-Power systems)
* Punching & shearing combo machines with automation

The production includes forming, marking, tapping, punching, and complex sheet metal forming operations. The most suitable machine is always selected based on efficiency and product requirements.


What we expect from you

* Experience in sheet metal work (minimum 1–5 years preferred)
* Ability to read technical drawings
* Experience in CNC machine operation or programming
* Understanding of machining tolerances and production quality
* Finnish or English language skills


We offer

* Accommodation in company apartment (own room in a shared apartment in a block of flats – rent from 220€/month)
* Wage rates + supplements according to Finnish law
* Long-term employment opportunity
* Competitive hourly wage based on experience
* Help with registration and official matters by English, Polish, Bulgarian and Romanian speaking coordinators

jobs.title: Analog Design Engineer, ASIC
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Analog Design Engineer to join our ASIC Design Team in Finland. Our office is located in Vantaa, capital region area of Finland.

Murata Finland is developing leading edge gyroscope and accelerometer safety-critical sensors for global automotive, industrial and healthcare markets. We design full custom mixed mode ASICs from concept level to volume production including wafer level testing. Murata has flexible remote work policy and way of working can be planned according to your personal needs. The job includes on-site work, and part of it can also be done remotely.

In this role your main responsibility areas are:

· ASIC design, verification and reporting

- Including modules like bandgap, LDO, PLL, ADC, DAC, different SC-circuits and high voltage circuits.


· Characterization specifications and result analysis

· Support for production wafer test and result analysis

To be successful in this role, these are the expected qualities and skills:

· Technical education (e.g. M.Sc) with emphasis on microelectronics

· Basic understanding of the most common analog blocks (e.g. opamps, current mirrors, voltage references, AD/DA converters)

· Some design experience in analog ASIC design from industry or university projects

·You have experience or readiness to learn

- Design and verification of analog blocks using EDA tools

- Layout design using EDA tools

- Modeling and simulation of analog blocks with System Verilog

- Support of ASIC characterization

- Modeling and simulation system solutions with Matlab or Simulink-


· You communicate fluently in English

· Systematic and careful way of working

· You are innovative and interested in working in an international environment

Our culture is based on our values, which are employee satisfaction and customer satisfaction, and we have agreed together what the values mean in practice. We call this cultural etiquette. According to our cultural etiquette we strengthen employee satisfaction by helping each other, treating each other equally and friendly as well as open discussion culture. We also strengthen customer satisfaction by being proactive and innovative and always thinking what our customer needs. Would this kind of work community suit you?

This is an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology contributing to the advancement of society. We believe that the tiniest things can have the greatest impact. With our innovative sensor technology, cars remain in their lanes, peoples hearts keep beating and bridges do not collapse. The combination of our Finnish and Japanese capabilities will enable safe and autonomous driving – in all places.

For more information, please contact the hiring manager Juha Syvänen, tel. +358 40 641 6301 (after 3rd August 2026) or e-mail juha.syvanen@murata.com. Juha is pleased to tell you more about Murata and the job. Please send your application with resume and salary expectations via the link latest on 12th Aug 2026. Our hiring team is on vacation during July so we will start browsing through applications in August. Interviews will be held around calendar weeks 34 and 35. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

Read more about Murata at www.muratafinland.com and follow us in LinkedIn (Murata), Instagram (@muratafinland) and Facebook (@MurataFinland).

From our News & Stories, you can read more about what it's like to work at Murata and find out if Murata is the right workplace for you! You can read about the different teams, the study and career path opportunities, as well as how development and growth appear at Murata, from product development to production work.

Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu uinninopetus, vesiliikuntaryhmien ohjaus ja uinninvalvonta sekä Kaukaveden palveluiden suunnitteluun ja viestintään liittyvät tehtävät. Arvostamme asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä yhteistyökykyä monien asiakasryhmien sekä työyhteisön kesken.

Tehtävän kelpoisuutena on soveltuva liikunta-alan tutkinto. Eduksi katsomme hakijalta SUH Ry:n uimaopettaja- ja uinninvalvojatutkintoja sekä aikaisempaa työkokemusta liikunnanohjaajan työstä.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä 30 päivän kuluessa valitsemispäätöksen tiedoksisaannista nähtäväksi lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä erikseen pyydettäessä todistus huumausainetestistä. Tehtävän koeaika on neljä kuukautta.

Ennen tehtävän alkamista työntekijän tulee suorittaa Kuluttajaviraston säädöksien mukainen hengenpelastusuinti hyväksyttävästi.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus määräytyy Kunnallisen yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Työ on viikonlopputyötä sisältävää kaksivuorotyötä.

Ympäristötekninen toimiala

Ympäristöteknisellä toimialalla näet työsi jäljen konkreettisesti päivittäin. Huolehdimme siitä, että Kajaani on viihtyisä ja sujuva kaupunki: kadut ja puistot ovat kunnossa, liikuntapaikat kutsuvat liikkumaan ja rakennettu ympäristö kehittyy kestävän kehityksen periaatteiden mukaisesti.

Toimiala vastaa laajasti mm. kaavoituksesta ja maankäytöstä, kunnallistekniikasta, toimitiloista, kiinteistöistä, liikuntapalveluista sekä rakennusvalvonnasta ja ympäristönsuojelusta. Meillä työskentelee ammattilaisia suunnittelijoista ja insinööreistä kunnossapidon osaajiin ja lupaviranomaisiin. Työnantajana Kajaanin ympäristötekninen toimiala tarjoaa sinulle monipuolisia työtehtäviä, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja olla mukana suunnittelemassa ja toteuttamassa tulevaisuuden Kajaania yhdessä muiden toimialojen,kumppaneiden ja kaupunkilaisten kanssa.

Kajaanin kaupunki on monialainen työnantaja, joka arvostaa työn ja perhe-elämän tasapainoa. Perheiden monimuotoisuus nähdään vahvuutena, ja haluamme kehittää jatkuvasti käytäntöjämme entistä perheystävällisemmiksi. Lue lisää Kajaanin kaupungista työnantajana: kuntarekry.fi/kajaaninkaupunki

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja
jobs.description:
Haetaan lähihoitajaa mielenterveyskuntoutujien palvelukotiin. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa, joka sisältää myös yksintyöskentelyä. Työntekijältä vaaditaan oma-aloitteisuutta, luotettavuutta sekä yhteistyötaitoja. Valmiutta ja rohkeutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja kykyä kohdata asukkaat rauhallisesti ja ennakkoluulottomasti. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä. Työ sisältää asukkaiden ohjausta ja avustamista kaikissa arkipäivän asioissa sekä kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä. Arjen pyörittäminen, kuten ruoan laitto, siivous, pyykkihuolto ja kaupassa käynti ovat tärkeä osa työtäsi. Tehtävät tehdään yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toimintakykyään tukien ja vahvistaen. Vastaat asukkaiden turvallisesta lääkehoidosta ja dokumentoinnista.

Kyseessä aluksi määräaikainen työsuhde 30.8.2026 saakka ja sen jälkeen työtä tarjolla joustavasti. Saat pitkän ja huolellisen perehdytyksen kokeneiden työntekijöiden rinnalla. Perehdytystä jatketaan aina niin kauan, kunnes tunnet olosi täysin varmaksi, ennen ensimmäistä itsenäistä työvuoroasi. Palkkaus määräytyy Yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukaisesti. Tervetuloa mukaan avoimeen, rempseään ja mukavaan työporukkaamme.

Kontroliuoti transporto priemonių ridą, alyvų, filtrų, padangų būklę ir techninės priežiūros periodiškumą.
Organizuoti transporto priemonių techninius aptarnavimus, remontus ir technines apžiūras.
Užtikrinti savalaikį transporto priemonių civilinės atsakomybės ir KASKO draudimų pratęsimą.
Vesti transporto priemonių remonto, techninės priežiūros ir profilaktikos dokumentaciją.
Kontroliuoti racionalų medžiagų ir mechanizmų naudojimą.
Užtikrinti, kad transporto priemones eksploatuojantys darbuotojai laikytųsi saugos ir sveikatos, gaisrinės saugos bei kitų teisės aktų reikalavimų.

Hours: 39 hours per week Job Summary Benova E-Commerce Ltd trading as IT STAR is an Irish retailer specialising in the sale of new and refurbished mobile phones, tablets, laptops and technology accessories. We are seeking an experienced Import & Export Coordinator to coordinate the import and export of technology products from overseas suppliers. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing international shipments, customs documentation, customs compliance and logistics activities to ensure the efficient movement of goods into Ireland. Liaise with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers and shipping companies to ensure the timely movement of goods. Monitor shipments and resolve any transportation, customs or documentation issues. Coordinate shipping schedules and maintain communication with overseas suppliers regarding deliveries. Maintain accurate import/export records and shipping documentation. Provide shipment updates and logistics information to management and relevant departments. Support the continuous improvement of import/export processes and customs compliance. Assist with international returns and warranty shipments where required. Requirements Qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Business or a related field is preferred. Minimum 2 years' experience in import/export, logistics or freight forwarding. Knowledge of import/export procedures, customs documentation and international shipping. Experience coordinating international shipments and working with overseas suppliers. Good command in Mandarin Chinese and Cantonese (spoken and written). Proficient in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational and communication skills. Experience importing consumer electronics or technology products is an advantage.
