jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Product Sales Specialist - Pet Health (CST timezone)
jobs.description:
Must Love Dogs!!

At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.

At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work. That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.


What You'll Do:

  • Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!

  • Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.

  • Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.

  • Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.

  • Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

 

What's In It For You:

  • Earnings: This is a commission-only role. You will have between 8 and 18 appointments scheduled for you each day (more if you want them and you are closing sales). You will earn a 20% commission on the gross margin of every sale you make. Please tell us how much you want to earn, and we will show you what it takes to get there. Each sale is between $250 and $2,500.

  • The Tribe Tool Kit: We have a battle-tested tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including Rippling and Salesforce, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.

  • Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Highly-driven self starters, who are motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.

  • Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.

  • Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.

  • The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.

  • Reliable internet and equipment are required. Because this position involves frequent phone and video calls, you’ll need a setup that can support clear, uninterrupted conversations.

    This means you should have:

    • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a headset, so you can comfortably run our call system, Salesforce, and Zoom at the same time.

    • Ethernet connection strongly preferred because it provides the most consistent call quality. (Usually requires only an inexpensive cable you plug into your desktop/laptop and modem.)

    • Enough dedicated internet speed to support calls and video without freezing, delays, or dropped audio. Minimum [10] Mbps download / [5] Mbps upload of dedicated bandwidth, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1%.

Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

jobs.title: Product Quality & Configuration Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a driven Product Quality & Compliance Engineer to lead product quality, digital traceability and defence compliance across our R&D, production, and supplier ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development, quality, and compliance. Your focus will be on owning and embedding digital traceability across our R&D and production processes, ensuring quality, consistency, and transparency throughout the product lifecycle, while maintaining and continually improving our ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS).

You will be Quadsat’s core quality and compliance ambassador both internally and externally, working across R&D, Production, Supply Chain, Commercial, and with our customers to ensure our products meet the highest standards without compromising the agility and innovation that define Quadsat.

A key part of the role will be to build and own the practical configuration management and digital traceability system that connects engineering work, product releases, BOMs, SBOMs, verification evidence, production builds, defects, and delivered product configurations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving quality and compliance across our engineering and production ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis you can expect to:

  • Drive and govern product quality assurance from early concept and design stage through to verification, production, release and lifecycle support.

  • Build, own, and continuously improve Quadsat’s configuration management and digital traceability setup across tools such as Jira, Confluence, PDM, and production records, ensuring that product baselines, releases, BOMs, SBOMs, defects, deviations, and delivered product configurations are controlled and actively used.

  • Own the engineering governance and digital traceability framework in our Jira environment, including workflow and issue structures, traceability, dashboards, release planning and other related processes.

  • Support the R&D Director in managing development activities through Jira, ensuring that processes and requirements are effectively planned, tracked, and integrated into development and release workflows.

  • Coordinate development cycle reviews, compliance reporting, and engineering metrics using Jira data and provide insights to the R&D Director, developers and other stakeholders to enable informed quality-driven decision-making.

  • Coordinate internal and external product testing activities required to demonstrate product performance, quality, and compliance.

  • Lead compliance initiatives to prepare Quadsat's products and engineering processes for future qualification against defence and customer-specific standards, including frameworks such as MIL-STD, STANAG, AQAP, and DO-178, as required by our customers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Quadsat's ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring effective governance, process maturity, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Educational background in engineering or technical field.

  • Proven experience working in a quality or compliance role, translating technical standards and compliance requirements into actionable engineering processes and development activities.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Solid understanding of risk management, DFMEA, requirements management, verification, validation, and test coverage methodologies.

  • You are a Jira super user with hands-on experience setting up and maintaining practical engineering governance, configuration management, release management, defect tracking, traceability, and compliance workflows in Jira or similar systems.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances agility, engineering effectiveness, and defense-grade quality expectations.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

All candidates must be eligible to obtain security clearance with the Danish Defence and NATO authorities.

Our Dynamic Work Environment

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and people who want their work to have a lasting impact beyond individual projects.

About Quadsat

Quadsat develops and builds long-range electronic warfare payloads and software that support multi-domain military operations through fast and precise radio frequency detection and geolocation across the electromagnetic spectrum. Our technology enables defense organizations to maintain mission-critical connectivity, ensure resilient communication infrastructures, and achieve operational readiness.

Contact

For recruitment related questions please contact Aislinn Campbell, HR Director, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: Job i udlandet -Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og gratis professionel rådgivning af Cathrine.
jobs.description:
Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og professionel rådgivning så du kommer trygt afsted.

Jeg hedder Cathrine, og jeg arbejder hos JobHuntWorldwide. Jeg kender følelsen af at stå med lysten til at tage af sted, men ikke helt vide, hvordan man gør det. Det er præcis derfor, jeg er her, til at gøre processen nem og tryg for dig.

Drømmer du om at bruge dit sabbatår på noget helt andet end hverdagen i Danmark? Jeg hjælper unge danskere med at finde arbejde i udlandet – både hvis du vil udvikle dig fagligt, møde nye mennesker eller bare prøve noget helt nyt for en periode.

Vi samarbejder med virksomheder i bl.a. Spanien, Grækenland, Portugal, Malta, Cypern, Vietnam og Filippinerne, og mange stillinger kræver ingen tidligere erfaring.

Hvad kan du forvente?

✔ Gratis og uforpligtende karrieresamtale

Vi starter altid med en personlig snak om dine ønsker for dit sabbatår. Vil du opkvalificeres? Vil du have et socialt fællesskab? Eller vil du bare prøve noget helt nyt? Jeg hjælper dig med at finde den løsning, der passer til dig.

✔ Hjælp til at finde det rette job

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Du skal som udgangspunkt kunne sige ja til 4–6 måneder, og du får naturligvis betalt ferie, så du kan rejse hjem undervejs.

✔ Professionel forberedelse til jobinterview

Når vi har fundet et match, præsenterer jeg dig for virksomheden og klæder dig på til interviewet. Du får:

  • Feedback på dit CV

  • Råd om spørgsmål du bør stille

  • Forventningsafstemning om bolig, løn, kontrakt og praktiske forhold

Jeg følger dig hele vejen frem til din første arbejdsdag.

Hvilke typer job kan du få?

Der er mange muligheder – alt efter dine ønsker og kompetencer. Eksempler:

  • Kundeservice og teknisk support

  • Rejsebranchen og booking

  • Telemarketing og mødebooking

  • Reception og administration

  • Fundraising

  • Online kundekommunikation

  • Online gaming Presenter

  • Specialiserede roller (fx gaming support, ansvarlig spilrådgivning, medicinsk assistance)

Nogle stillinger inkluderer betalt fly, hotel eller firmabolig, afhængigt af landet og virksomheden.

Vigtige råd, før du siger ja.

Jeg hjælper dig med at træffe den rigtige beslutning ved at gennemgå bl.a.:

  • Arbejdsforhold og kontrakt

  • Boligmuligheder og økonomi

  • Løn, udbetaling og ferie

  • Oplæring og forventninger

  • Stabilitet i projektet

  • Hvad du ønsker at få ud af dit ophold

Det er vigtigt, at du vælger et job, der passer til dine mål – ikke bare det første og bedste.

Sådan kommer du i gang.

Du kan booke en gratis og uforpligtende karrieresnak med mig, hvor vi gennemgår dine muligheder og hjælper dig med at finde det rette match.

jobs.title: Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark? Måske er det tid til at du tager på det senere sabbatår i udlandet?
jobs.description:
Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det senere sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Hvorfor vælge udlandet som din nye start?
Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Mange virksomheder tilbyder oplæring, betalt ferie og interne udviklingsprogrammer, så du kan vokse i jobbet.

Praktiske overvejelser:
Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi hjælper dig med at afklare kontraktforhold, boligmuligheder, sundhedsforsikring og opsigelsesvilkår. Det er vigtigt at tale med en professionel karrierecoach, så du får den rette sparring og undgår dyre fejl.

Derfor er vi med dig hele vejen:
Vi afdækker dine kompetencer og ønsker. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til din profil. Vi forbereder dig til interviewet og sikrer, at du stiller de rigtige spørgsmål. Vi støtter dig frem til din første arbejdsdag – og videre, hvis du ønsker at udvikle dig i virksomheden.

Book en gratis samtale med en karrierecoach via rene@jobhuntworldwide.com Vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

Du kan lytte mere om hvordan vi kan hjælpe dig på vores Podcast du kan finde her: Lyt med!

jobs.title: Center for Engineering and Science ved Absalon søger en adjunkt eller lektor eller timelærere
jobs.description:
Føler du dig hjemme i grænselandet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0? Hvis ja skal du læse videre.

Er du drevet af at formidle og videregive din faglighed og erfaring?

Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

Absalon etablerer september 2027 ny diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i Robotteknologi og automation vil indgå i en tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i Maskinteknologi og efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske maskin-, automations- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet, der bl.a. rykker ind i et nyt campusbyggeri i september 2028. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, maskinteknologi og Industri 4.0. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Du er en dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Og det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Du medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og vi drives af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelse, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Med den rette profil får du en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af ny uddannelse med fokus på robotteknologi og automation Bl.a. skal vi i gang med at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Hvis du har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet, vil det være en fordel.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil i undervisningen, vejledningen og sparringen med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Safety-systemer og CE-mærkning
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
  • Teknisk dokumentation inden for maskin- og el-området.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør og er gerne lektorbedømt
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på dansk og også gerne på engelsk.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Undervise og projektvejlede de studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede de studerende teoretisk og værksteds- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen og samtidig være med til løbende at udvikle undervisningen.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan også knytte sig opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Ligesom det vil være en fordel, hvis du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift, samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesledere, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores uddannelser i Kalundborg er vi 20 ansatte undervisere, og ved Diplomingeniør i Maskinteknologi er vi fem lektorer og en adjunkt fast tilknyttet. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Fra 2028 vil vi være en del af nyt Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537, - kr. inkl. pension. Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 14. august 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 34 og 35.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.

På Absalon er adjunkturet en 3-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Head of Client Excellence (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Job description

Head of Client Excellence

We are looking for an experienced Head of Client Excellence to join a RegTech company providing SaaS solutions to the financial services industry. The company supports leading asset managers, management companies, depositaries, fund administrators, and other financial institutions in managing their oversight and controls, optimizing business processes, strengthening data governance, and automating operational workflows.
Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this is a senior, strategic, and hands-on position combining business development, sales, client excellence, operational transformation, and consulting. The successful candidate will lead strategic initiatives aimed at improving revenue
generation, service delivery, strengthening client relationships, and driving operational excellence while contributing to the company's commercial growth.

Core Expectations

• Build trusted relationships with clients while identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts and develop new business.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the financial services industry, particularly the asset management ecosystem and its operational challenges.
• Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and a strong sense of ownership.
• Provide strategic leadership across client excellence and professional services initiatives.
• Drive organizational improvements through process optimization, governance, and cross functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Commercial Growth

• Actively prospecting new organizations and initiating conversations with potential clients.
• Building and managing a strong commercial pipeline through structured prospecting, relationship development, and disciplined follow-up.
• Owning the full sales cycle, from initial engagement and solution presentation through negotiation and closing.
• Developing compelling business cases and demonstrating value to senior business and technical stakeholders.
• Setting and achieving ambitious business development targets linked to revenue growth and market expansion.
• Monitoring market trends, competitor positioning, and evolving clients needs to identify new opportunities.
• Supporting account expansion strategies, including upselling, cross-selling, and partner-led opportunities where relevant.
• Identify and develop new business opportunities within the financial services industry.

Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Drive process optimization initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
• Implement practical governance and reporting frameworks to support operational performance and decision-making.
• Develop KPIs and performance metrics to monitor delivery, resource utilization, and client outcomes.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement through structured feedback and best practice sharing.

Consultancy & Client Excellence

• Lead strategic initiatives to continuously improve client experience and professional services delivery.
• Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, supporting organizational transformation and change management initiatives.
• Develop scalable operating models, delivery standards, and best practices to enhance consistency and efficiency.
• Foster collaboration across Professional Services, Product, Commercial, and Technology teams to ensure seamless client delivery.
• Monitor delivery performance and recommend improvements to maximize client satisfaction and operational effectiveness.

Contracts, licensing, pricing and commercial models

• High familiarity and experience with making commercial proposals to customers.
• Have contracts and contract management in the fingers.
• Be able to seamlessly apply and guard licensing, pricing and contracting practices of the company.
• Can create new commercial models if and when needed.

Profile

Professional Qualifications

• Master's degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Management, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, business transformation, client success, or strategic leadership roles.
• Experience in process optimization, organizational improvement, and operational excellence.
• Good knowledge of the financial services industry, particularly asset management, including its operating models, regulatory environment, and key market participants.
• Experience working with SaaS, RegTech, FinTech, or technology-enabled services is highly desirable.
• Commercial mindset with experience developing client relationships and contributing to business growth.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence) is an advantage.
• Excellent communication skills in English; French or any additional language is considered an asset.

Personal Characteristics

• Strategic, hands-on, and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
• Excellent relationship builder, able to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
• Client-focused with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ideas into practical solutions.
• Highly communicative, team player with other functions such as Product and Finance, and dares to challenge customers by protecting the interest of the company when needed.
• High level of integrity, accountability, and collaborative spirit.

jobs.title: Electro-Mechanical Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:
About HITEC Founded in 1986, HITEC is a 100%-owned Luxembourg engineering and technology company with around 60 employees, designing and building high-technology solutions across satellite ground segment, mission-critical communications, industrial testing and measuring equipment, and intelligent traffic management systems. With a multi-disciplinary, client-centric approach, we serve private, institutional and public-sector clients nationally and internationally, in more than 30 countries.The successful candidate will work on the following product lines: satellite ground segment equipment, industrial testing instruments and mission-critical systems, across the full development cycle from concept, design and dimensioning to commissioning, testing and validation.
Your Activities
· Dimension and select motion related components such as motors, drive systems, controllers, motion safety components
· Design, dimension, implement, test and maintain electro-mechanical and motion-control solutions, including PLC code, for internal products and external customers
· Provide design and analysis services supporting product development across HITEC's business units, in close collaboration with mechanical engineering
· Actively support the testing process by maintaining and driving functional tests, using existing or new test plans
· Define, document, implement and test new features and technologies in existing or new products
· Start-up in-house designed machinery and commercial components
· Contribute to technical documentation and to the team's technology survey activities
· Occasional travel abroad (approximately 10 to 20%) for supplier and customer site visits, installations or commissioning may be required
· Interact with internal and external customers, partners and suppliers to support, integrate and promote HITEC's electrical and automated solutions
· Help develop and put in place best practices in product design and verification
· Pro-actively introduce, document and disseminate new technologies and concepts as part of the team's technology survey activities
· Collaborate across electrical, mechanical and software engineering within our small and cross-functional team Your Profile
· Engineer, Master's degree in electrical or automation engineering
· Control theory background and knowledge of PLC programming languages (PLCopen Structured Text)
· Knowlege of PC-based programming languages (Java, C++, C or Python) is considered a plus
· At least 5 years of relevant experience, including electro-mechanical devices such as electrical motors and power electronics
· A good understanding of safety risks related to electro-mechanical machinery and the related electrical safety concepts to address them
· Comfortable working in an English-speaking environment, including technical discussions and documentation; French, German or Luxembourgish considered a plus
· Ability to adapt to new situations and work with a variety of stakeholders and partners Why Join HITEC? A small, cross-functional teamThe engineering teams being relatively compact means that you will work across the full lifecycle of a product rather than one narrow task, that you are exposed to adjacent disciplines (electrical, mechanical, software), and people who join the team typically take on broader or more senior responsibilities faster than in larger organisations.
4 main fields of activity
HITEC Luxembourg develops, produces and maintains Satellite Ground Segment solutions for space and satellite applications used in commercial, defence and scientific projects. Over the past 25 years, we have provided numerous projects within Europe, from the tropics to the polar regions, ensuring secured and reliable operations for our customers.
The company develops and produces industrial Testing Instruments used in R&D and in quality control to measure physical properties of rubber fillers and battery materials. Being a reference on the market, our instruments are used worldwide by all major producers and users of these materials to ensure compliance with ASTM standards.
The Mission Critical offering enables organizations to communicate, collaborate and maintain real-time situational awareness when it matters most. From emergency response and defense operations to critical infrastructure and public safety, our solutions provide secure and resilient connectivity, enabling teams to access, share and act on critical information wherever they operate, even in the most challenging environments.
The Traffic Management department provides engineering and maintenance services for intelligent transportation systems. We design and implement cutting-edge smart mobility solutions that improve road safety, optimize traffic flow, and support sustainable transportation strategies for connected and autonomous mobility, while ensuring the reliability and performance of road infrastructure.
Decisions made in LuxembourgHITEC is independently owned and managed. Decisions about products, projects and people are made locally, by the people you work with on a daily basis.
Equipment deployed worldwideGround segment equipment designed by this team is installed on operational sites worldwide. Testing instruments are also sold worldwide and used daily by manufacturers in quality control and R&D.
An established, certified employerHITEC is ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified, holds the ESR (“Entreprise Socialement Responsable”) label from INDR, is a signatory of the IMS Diversity Charter, and has signed Luxembourg's National Pact “Business and Human Rights.”
Working in LuxembourgLuxembourg is a small, safe and multilingual country (English, French, German and Luxembourgish are all in common use at work), with one of the most international populations in Europe (over 170 nationalities live and work here). It offers a high standard of living, free public transport nationwide, good schools including international and European schools, accessible healthcare, and short distances overall: city, countryside and neighbouring countries are all close by. Its central European location also means easy access to most major European cities for travel (more information on https://workinluxembourg.com)For candidates from countries without a specific agreement with Luxembourg, the standard work permit process can also be relatively fast.
What we offer
· Work on satellite, mission-critical and industrial testing technologies used in more than 30 countries
· Involvement across the full product lifecycle, from concept to validation, with real project experience
· The opportunity to develop your skills in adjacent engineering fields
· A stimulating and entrepreneurial work environment
· A small, cross-functional engineering team with room to grow into broader responsibilities
· An independently-owned and managed Luxembourg company with local decision-making
· A competitive compensation package aligned with the Luxembourg / Grande Région engineering market We are looking for people, not perfect applications. Please tell us, in your own words, what you would bring to HITEC and why this role interests you.

jobs.title: R&T ENGINEER IN FUNGAL BIOINFORMATICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Among other responsibilities, you will:
·                  In coordination with the group leader be responsible for the organization of the group's laboratories and equipment, ordering of chemicals, and introducing new group members to the group and institute's way of working
·                  Manage the group's strain, enzyme and plasmid collection
·                  Conducts small RDI projects, work packages in projects of regular size and scope, or laboratory missions that require previous experience.
·                  Performs R&T tasks with autonomy: evaluates, selects, and applies technical methods; makes critical analysis, evaluation, and synthesis of data obtained from tests/experiments; proposes improvements to methods, techniques, or practices; evaluates the feasibility and effectiveness of solutions provided; explains methods, practices and procedures related to their work; explains the functioning, usage, and maintenance of specialised tools/equipment to less experienced colleagues; etc.
·                  Contributes to the identification and engagement of RDI funding (e.g., collaborative projects or service agreements). Provides support to on-going funding efforts. Is encouraged to define RDI project proposals under guidance.
·                  Contributes to the dissemination, valorisation, and transfer of RDI results. Presents work results at workshops and conferences.
·                  Respects and applies LIST-HSE rules. Alerts of potential dangers or risks. Takes care of their own safety and that of others.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

Master's degree (or equivalent) in molecular biology or biotechnology
Experience with molecular methodologies, such as cloning, RNA/gDNA isolation, PCR, etc.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Experience with enzymes assays and/or HPLC analysis is an asset
Experience with fungi is an asset
Ability and willingness to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Language skills

Strong knowledge of English (both spoken and written) is required.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·        Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·        Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·        Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:
·        A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·        A scientific CV with contact details
·        List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
·        Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements


This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79222–€86814 annually) based on full-time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
It is to be noted that LIST also offers real opportunities for career growth, both in terms of responsibilities and salary progression, as employees develop within LIST

CSC is the world's leading provider of business, legal, financial, and digital brand services to companies around the globe. From keeping your business in compliance and streamlining operations, to protecting and promoting your brand online, we use our expertise and personal approach to help your business run smoother.

CSC is seeking a creative, inquisitive, and detail-oriented student join the Capital Market team. If you are heading toward a career in accounting, our intern program may be just what you need to see a broad and inside view of a vibrant business-to-business company.

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
• Strong professional experience in audit, financial reporting, and consolidation matters, ideally within the Luxembourg financial sector
• Solid knowledge of IFRS, particularly in the context of holding structures, real estate, and private equity
• Familiarity with consolidation tools/software is a strong asset
• Excellent communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented mindset
• Detail-oriented, adaptable, and hands-on, with the ability to thrive under tight deadlines
• Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is essential

jobs.title: Risk Manager Power & Gas (m/w/d) Trading (Risk-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Die team Gruppe kümmert sich mit rund 5.000 Mitarbeitenden um die Grundbedürfnisse aller Menschen: Ob es um die Ernährung, die Gestaltung von Wohn- und Lebensräumen oder um Energie für den Alltag geht. Als wichtiger Teil dieser Gruppe bietet die team SE mit ihren rund 350 engagierten Mitarbeitenden zentrale Dienstleistungen, die diese Mission in allen Geschäftsbereichen der team Gruppe vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Verantwortung für die Risikosteuerung im Energiehandel. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Power‑ und Gas‑Portfolios über Ländergrenzen hinweg transparent, kontrolliert und im Einklang mit der konzernweit definierten Risikobereitschaft gesteuert werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Überwachung von Commodity-, Markt-, Kredit- und operationellen Risiken für Strom, Gas und Zertifikate (GO’s, VERs, Biomethan, EUA2) sowie tägliche Steuerung der Clearing‑Konten
- Entwicklung und Pflege von Exposure‑Reports & Dashboards für eine transparente und granulare Risikoübersicht in Echtzeit
- Durchführung von Stresstests, Szenarioanalysen und Backtesting zur Bewertung potenzieller Verluste und Treasury‑Auswirkungen
- Modellierung und Controlling von Risikoparametern (Spot, Ausgleichsenergie, Hedging, Volatilität, Margin)
- Validität Price-Forward-Curve
- Entwicklung von Modellen und Prozessen zur besseren Risikokontrolle
- Sicherstellung regulatorischer Compliance (z.B. REMIT, MiFIR, MiFID, usw.) sowie Governance über Limits, Handelskontrollen und Eskalationsprotokolle
- Bewertung von risikoadjustierter Performance (VaR, Margin‑at‑Risk, P&L‑Attribution)

Dein Profil:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Finance, Wirtschaft, Mathematik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Risikomanagement von Energiehandel (Power & Gas)
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in VaR, Margin-at-Risk, Stresstests, Backtesting
- Sicherer Umgang mit Risikomanagement-Software und Datenanalyse-Tools
- Analytische Fähigkeiten, Detailgenauigkeit und starke Entscheidungsstärke
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch sowie Teamfähigkeit
- Du bringst Kenntnisse in Datenmodellierung und Systemintegration mit
-
Starte zum nächstmöglichen Termin in eine spannende und unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in Hamburg oder Fredericia und werde Teil der dynamischen Welt des Power & Gas Tradings – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We’re looking for a Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to own strategic sourcing and supplier management across critical areas of our company.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to lead sourcing processes, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make clear decisions across cost, quality, speed, risk, and experience.

We’re opening this role to bring strategic sourcing support earlier into the decision-making process, helping leaders clarify the right approach, surface trade-offs, and move faster with confidence as Notion scales. Done well, this role will drive savings and cost avoidance while helping us build supplier agreements that protect the business and support how our teams work.

You’ll be a close partner to our HR and Facilities teams in particular, building sourcing plans that translate business needs into the right supplier strategy, sourcing motion, and negotiation posture.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Deliver measurable savings and cost avoidance across Corporate Services spend, helping fund new initiatives while protecting service quality.

 - Build strategic procurement plans with business partners, starting with HR and Facilities/Real Estate, translating business needs into clear sourcing strategies and negotiation plans.

 - Operate as an extension of stakeholder teams—surfacing trade-offs early, aligning on decisions, and driving clean execution without last-minute fire drills.

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure deals the business can live with: clear commercial terms, understood budget impacts, and risk-aware contracting.

 - Reduce risk across our vendor portfolio by strengthening contract coverage, supplier governance, and performance management routines.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, category management, or a related field, including 3+ years owning Corporate Services categories such as Facilities/Real Estate, HR Services, Travel, Marketing Services, or Contingent Workforce.

 - Experience independently leading complex sourcing events end to end, including RFx, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical rigor, including spend analysis, benchmarking, building business cases, and measuring savings/cost avoidance.

 - Deep understanding of source to contract and procure to pay practices, with the ability to guide teams through intake, approvals, vendor onboarding, POs, and contract handoffs without slowing the business down.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with teams such as Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, and Compliance, including command of key commercial and legal terms and a track record of reducing risk while delivering value.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $180,000 per year.

jobs.title: Project Architect (data centers)
jobs.description:
Laitila Architects has an exceptionally strong routine and long experience in permitting and localizing demanding international data center projects in Finland. We have worked in numerous billion-euro hyperscale data center projects as a permit team leader, architectural, landscape and principal designer, as well as a Due Diligence expert.

In this role, you will be part of our localization team and ensure that our international clients' massive concepts are smoothly adapted to Finnish legislation and regulatory requirements. Your tasks may also include more traditional architectural and principal design of industrial and business premises.

Laitila Architects is an architecture firm focused on creating functional, people-centered spaces that support smoother everyday life for businesses and organizations. The firm has extensive experience in designing residential, office, commercial, and industrial environments, covering both new construction and renovation projects. Laitila Architects emphasizes solutions that are appropriately scaled and tailored to the specific needs of each client. The company operates as part of United Founders, a community of seasoned construction industry professionals, offering multidisciplinary expertise and collaboration opportunities. This setting provides team members with a supportive professional network and diverse project work.

**Role Description**

The Architect / Principal Designer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Helsinki, with the flexibility to work partly from home. In this position, the architect will lead and develop architectural concepts, prepare design documentation, and act as principal designer in projects from early planning to execution. Daily tasks include coordinating with clients, engineers, and other stakeholders, ensuring compliance with regulations, and aligning designs with project budgets and schedules. The role involves overseeing project integration across disciplines, participating in design reviews, and guiding junior team members. The architect will also contribute to continuous improvement of internal design processes and digital tools used in project delivery.

**We expect from you:**

- **Education and experience:** You have a relevant university degree in architecture (within EU), and eligibility or licensure to act as principal designer (pääsuunnittelija) in Finland, and preferably previous work experience in the design of data center and/or industrial projects. Understanding of Integration between architectural, structural, and building systems, and ability to collaborate effectively with other design disciplines. Competence in Project Management, including planning, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and quality control. Proactive, organized, and able to take responsibility for project outcomes in a collaborative, non-hierarchical work environment.

- **Software expertise:** We primarily use **Autodesk Revit** BIM software in our projects. In addition, we consider knowledge of other tools we use (AutoCAD, Solibri Model Checker, Twinmotion) to be an advantage.

- **Authority expertise:** You have excellent knowledge of Finnish building regulations and local permit processes, as well as construction practices.

- **Language skills:** We constantly work with international design teams and clients, so we require fluent Finnish and English language skills.


**What do we offer?**

**A unique project portfolio:** You will get to work with real large-scale international projects as well as significant domestic industrial players.

**Agile and supportive work community:** We are part of **the United Founders** expert network, which offers its shareholder companies and employees the flexibility of a small company but the resources of a large organization and multidisciplinary expert support (e.g. structural, fire and building technology in the same ecosystem).

**Competitive benefits:** We offer, among other things, a separate incentive scheme (customer acquisition bonus) for bringing new business to the company.

**Job-specific salary 4500 – 5500 eur/month**

jobs.title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.

Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.

More info at: www.europcar-mobility-group.com

jobs.title: Head Waiter / Head Waitress for Restaurant Aihki | Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description:
**Join the award-winning team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**

We are looking for a **Head Waiter / Head Waitress**to join Restaurant Aihki, part of the Sunday Morning Resort in the heart of Pyhätunturi.

Restaurant Aihki is known for its modern Nordic cuisine, where locally sourced, pure ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).

As our Head Waiter / Head Waitress, you will be responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the dining room as well as special events. You will lead, inspire and support the front-of-house team while ensuring outstanding service and memorable guest experiences. Working closely with our kitchen leadership, you will oversee the daily operations of the restaurant floor, maintain service quality and contribute to the continued development of our dining experience.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, taking responsibility and delivering exceptional hospitality. You approach your work with ambition, creativity and professionalism, while possessing excellent organisational and communication skills. Previous supervisory experience in hospitality is highly valued, together with a relevant education in the restaurant industry. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about hospitality and committed to creating unforgettable guest experiences.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Leading the daily front-of-house operations at Restaurant Aihki

- Welcoming and serving guests with professionalism and genuine warmth during breakfast, lunch and dinner service

- Supervising, training and motivating the restaurant team

- Ensuring excellent guest service and supporting upselling opportunities

- Maintaining the highest standards of food and beverage service

- Coordinating wine service and contributing to the development of wine lists and beverage recommendations together with the restaurant and kitchen teams

- Managing the wine cellar and beverage inventory together with the restaurant and kitchen teams

- Collaborating with the kitchen management in planning menus, special events and dining experiences

- Maintaining quality standards, guest satisfaction and close cooperation with the wider management team


**We are looking for someone who has:**

- Previous supervisory experience in a restaurant environment, preferably in fine dining or high-quality à la carte service

- An excellent customer service mindset and strong interpersonal skills

- The ability to remain organised, calm and positive under pressure

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt quickly to changing situations

- Good command of Finnish and English (additional languages are considered an advantage)

- A relevant qualification in hospitality or restaurant management, together with a willingness to continue developing professionally

- A genuine interest in high-quality food, wines and memorable dining experiences

- A valid Hygiene Passport and Alcohol Serving Passport


**We offer you:**

- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's most highly regarded restaurants, recognised for its modern Nordic cuisine

- An inspiring and unique workplace surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland

- A varied and responsible role where you can develop your skills and contribute to the restaurant's future

- A welcoming, professional and close-knit team

- Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins

- The possibility of staff accommodation at an affordable rent

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits

- Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort during the winter season

- The opportunity to work in a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company

- An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services

- A competitive salary based on the MARA collective agreement, with the final salary determined according to your experience and qualifications


**Employment**

The position begins in **late November or early December 2026** and continues until the end of the winter season in **late March / early April 2027**.

This is a **full-time seasonal position**.

**About us**

Restaurant Aihki offers modern Nordic cuisine inspired by the pure flavours of Finnish Lapland. We create memorable dining experiences built around local ingredients, seasonal produce and respect for the surrounding Arctic nature. Alongside traditional Lapland flavours, our cuisine embraces contemporary Scandinavian influences, creating dishes that always have a story to tell.

Throughout the season we organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings, giving our team the opportunity to participate in exciting culinary experiences beyond everyday restaurant service.

Take a look at our Instagram **@restaurantaihki** to see some of our previous events and culinary experiences.

Restaurant Aihki is part of **Sunday Morning Resort**, a boutique hotel offering personalised hospitality and unforgettable experiences in the heart of Pyhätunturi. Together with Parkside Pyhä apartments, our sustainable activity services and award-winning dining experiences, **Sunday Morning Collection** creates authentic and high-quality Lapland experiences for guests from around the world.

Learn more about Restaurant Aihki: **https://sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**

**Interested?**

Please send your application with the subject:

**Head Waiter / Head Waitress - Restaurant Aihki / \[Your Name\]**

Include your CV and salary expectation, and tell us about your background, experience and why this role interests you.

We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

**Applications and enquiries**

- **rekry@sundaymorning.fi**

- **https://sundaymorning.fi**

- A warm and genuine customer service attitude

jobs.title: Fertility Specialist
jobs.description:
Employment: Full-time or Part-time (3 days/week)
Start date: As soon as possible
International applicants from EU countries are encouraged to apply.

Join one of Denmark’s leading private fertility clinics

Sellmer Fertility Clinic is an established and highly specialised private fertility clinic located in the heart of Aarhus, Denmark. They provide evidence-based fertility treatment in a modern, patient-centred environment, helping individuals and couples realise their dream of becoming parents.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

Whether you are seeking a permanent position or a flexible part-time opportunity alongside your current role, we would like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

Unlike many fertility clinics, our clinical setup allows for an excellent work-life balance:

  • Flexible working arrangements and no work at the weekends.

  • Modern private clinic with highly experienced teams

  • Opportunity to influence clinical development

For candidates with the right experience and ambitions, there may also be the opportunity to develop into a Responsible Physician role in the future.

Your Responsibilities

As a Fertility Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality fertility care throughout the patient journey, including:

  • Conducting consultations with IVF and IUI patients, including fertility assessments and evaluation of pregnancy potential.

  • Planning and managing ovarian stimulation protocols for IVF and IUI treatment.

  • Performing ultrasound examinations and follicular monitoring.

  • Performing hysterosalpingo-contrast sonography (HyCoSy/HSU).

  • Performing oocyte retrieval procedures.

  • Performing embryo transfer procedures.

  • Performing TESA procedures.

  • Diagnosing and managing fertility-related conditions, including PCOS and endometriosis.

  • Managing treatment-related complications, including infection, bleeding and ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).

  • Managing egg donation programmes, including donor assessment and evaluation.

  • Managing acute complications related to assisted reproductive treatment.

  • Developing and maintaining clinical treatment protocols and guidelines.

  • Interpreting laboratory results, including blood tests.

  • Performing donor approval and donor work-up in accordance with applicable regulations.

  • Contributing to the training, supervision and professional development of clinical staff.

Your Profile

We are looking for a physician who:

  • Is a licensed medical specialist within Obstetrics & Gynaecology

  • Has experience within reproductive medicine and assisted reproduction

  • Is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care

  • Works independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team

  • Enjoys a collaborative, quality-focused clinical environment

  • Communicates confidently in English

Why Denmark?

Denmark is internationally recognised as one of the world’s leading countries within reproductive medicine and fertility treatment.

Living and working in Denmark offers:

  • Excellent work-life balance

  • High professional standards

  • Modern healthcare system

  • Safe society with a high quality of life

  • International working environment

The clinic also offers help with providing accommodation for the days you’ll be working at the clinic.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Fertility Specialist looking for a rewarding opportunity in one of Scandinavia’s most respected private fertility clinics, we would be delighted to have a conversation with you.

jobs.description:
Vi tilbyder længere vikariater i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på din trivsel!

Kan du sige ja til at du er mødestabil og klar på nye udfordringer? Så læs mere her!

Om jobbet:

VKAREN.DK søger altid nye engagerede produktionsmedarbejdere til Dan-Foam i Aarup. Der er tale om længerevarende vikariater med opstart løbende og med gode muligheder for forlængelse og fastansættelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært foregå i madrasafdelingen, hvor du skal montere betræk på madrasserne. Her står du sammen med en kollega, hvor I sammen monterer betrækket ved hjælp af en maskine. Arbejdet kræver, at du er i fysisk god form, da det kan være tungt og med gentagende bevægelser, og størstedelen af arbejdet foregår stående.

Du er i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger hele tiden, og det gode samarbejde er altafgørende for, at I lykkes. Du får en høj grad af frihed under ansvar, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger i teamet skal sikre, at alle opgaver løses på bedste vis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat, så du kan hjælpe med at flytte paller, hente materialer eller løse andre forefaldende opgaver – det er dog ikke et krav til stillingerne.

Vi søger løbende medarbejdere til både dag- og nathold.

Arbejdstider dag:

·         1. uge: onsdag-torsdag 07-19.

·         2. uge: mandag-tirsdag og fredag-lørdag 07-19.

Arbejdstider nat:

·         Søndag-tirsdag 19-07.

·         Onsdag-fredag 19-07.

Vi forventer:

Det er ikke afgørende, at du har relevant erhvervserfaring, da der er en grundig oplæring. Vi forventer dog, at:

·         Du trives med fysisk arbejde i højt tempo.

·         Du har en høj arbejdsmoral og går til opgaverne med engagement.

·         Du er fortrolig med IT og er ikke bange for at benytte det i din hverdag.

·         Du taler, læser og skriver dansk.

·         Det er en fordel med truckcertifikat, men det er ikke et krav.

Din profil:

Som kollega møder du ind med en positiv indstilling og en arbejdsgejst, der smitter af på dine kollegaer. Du er god til at holde hovedet koldt, selv når det går stærkt, og dine kolleger kan altid regne med dig. Du er mødestabil, kvalitetsbevidst og pligtopfyldende samt en holdspiller, der gerne strækker sig lidt ekstra for at hjælpe en kollega. Den samme indstilling vil du opleve fra dine kolleger, og det er dét, der gør jer til et godt team.

Vi tilbyder:

Vi tilbyder en spændende mulighed i en velrenommeret virksomhed, hvor der er en sund kultur, og hvor godt kollegaskab vægtes højt. Du bliver en del af en global, succesfuld virksomhed med en førende position og stærke kvalitetsbrands. Koncernen er ambitiøs og kontinuerligt i udvikling, og du bliver en del af en veletableret og professionel kvalitet set up med engagerede og fagligt kompetente kolleger.

Når du starter, vil der være et nøje planlagt oplæringsforløb, og du vil blive taget imod med åbne arme på din første dag. Der er mulighed for køb af mad i kantinen, og du har desuden muligheden for at benytte dig af virksomhedens motionsrum.

Din løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst.

Om virksomheden:

Dan-Foam er Tempur Sealys centrale produktionsenhed til det internationale marked. Virksomheden udvikler, producerer og håndterer et enestående, men også komplekst produktprogram bestående af puder, madrasser, sengesystemer og accessoires, som sælges i mere end 90 lande.

Ansøgning:

Er du interesseret i stillingen, så tøv ikke med at sende dit cv og en ansøgning til jobfyn@vkaren.dk, mrk. ”Produktionsmedarbejder – Dan-Foam”.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte os på tlf. 70152010 alle hverdage mellem kl. 09.00 og 16.00.
