jobs.title: Ensure robust operational safety and crisis leadership at Kongsberg Maritime as Director Security and Crisis Management
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on an exciting and important journey as the Director Security & Crisis Management at Kongsberg Maritime? As the leader of our Security & Crisis Management team you will play a crucial role in driving our security efforts and delivering reliable solutions to our global operations.

Within the group security office our mission is clear: to build and enhance strategic and operational security and deliver reliable and sustainable security management to our valued operatives. Through a collaborative approach, both internally and externally, we will foster a security focused culture together. With a constant focus on uncertainty, we explore new technologies and ways to work to stay ahead of the unknown.

As the Director Security & Crisis Management in Kongsberg Maritime, you have the competence, motivation, and leadership to transform our security goals into actionable strategies that make a difference. You will effectively assess, strategize and communicate plans and initiatives to our organisation, fostering successfully implemented security strategies on a global scale.

Your key accountabilities include:

  • Be Kongsberg Maritime’s main point of contact in Security related issues
  • Own KM’s Security strategy, set targets and core focus within the area in line with KM direction and external factors
  • Provide relevant security briefings to KM Leadership team both regularly and in case of actual incidents
  • Ensure professional and updated threat assessments and plans for crisis management
  • Ensure KM operates within relevant laws and regulation
  • Responsible for KM’s global Security & Crisis Management team
  • Report to SVP Naval Systems and the CEO at Kongsberg Maritime

Qualifications and experience for the role

  • Relevant higher education at master or bachelor level within relevant fields
  • Broad experience from one or more areas like physical security, personnel security, crisis management, cyber security
  • Experience from and knowledge of risk governance

  • Background from either military or police is preferred

This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed.

Who are you?

As a person, we believe you excel in analysing complex problems, stays focused during stressful situations with high level of uncertainty and develop executable plans.

You take initiative, make things happen, and take full responsibility for the results. Your ability to lead, work independently and collaborate will be crucial in driving security initiatives forward.

You believe in the value of teamwork and understand the importance of supporting and empowering others. Your willingness to share your expertise, experiences, and support will contribute to a positive and inclusive work environment.

jobs.description:
Mariehamns stad söker två lärare i barnomsorgen för tillsvidareanställning på heltid från och med 1.9.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Sista ansökningsdag 12.8.2026.

FORMELLA BEHÖRIGHETSKRAV
Behörighet enligt landskapsförordning (2020:99) om barnomsorg och grundskola.
Har du svensk examen? Ansök med ett erkännande från Ålands landskapsregering som bifogas ansökan.
Saknar du full behörighet? Har du relevant utbildning och erfarenhet kan du ändå komma i fråga för en tidsbegränsad anställning om inga behöriga sökande finns.

VI SÖKER DIG SOM
Vill bidra till att barn får trygga, roliga och stimulerande uppväxtvillkor
Har ett engagerat, respektfullt och professionellt förhållningssätt till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor
Är nyfiken och vill utvecklas tillsammans med arbetslaget
Sprider arbetsglädje, ser möjligheter i vardagen och delar med dig av erfarenheter

VARFÖR DU KOMMER ATT TRIVAS HOS OSS
Hos oss möts du av god personaltäthet, trygghet och gemenskap. Vi värnar om ett nära och stödjande samarbete, både inom arbetslaget och med det breda nätverk som finns runt barnen. I vardagen samarbetar vi med bland annat kurator, talterapeut, speciallärare och socionom - en styrka som gör att vi kan ge varje barn bästa möjliga stöd och förutsättningar att utvecklas.

Varje daghem har dessutom en egen barnskötarpool, som fungerar som korttidsvikarie vid behov, utöver grundbemanningen, vilket ger flexibilitet och trygghet i verksamheten.

Inom barnomsorgen pågår flera inspirerande utvecklingsarbeten - bland annat satsningar på välbefinnande, NPF-anpassning av lärmiljöer och positiv psykologi.

VI ERBJUDER DIG OCKSÅ
Sjukvårdtjänster
Friskvårdsförmåner
Arbetskläder
Möjlighet till utbytesledighet

Tack vare korta avstånd mellan arbetsplatser får du dessutom mer tid till fritid och återhämtning.

ARBETSTID & SEMESTER
Arbetstid för heltid :38,25 timmar i veckan. För lärare ingår i dessa timmar en planeringstid om 4,5 timmar per vecka
Semester: 38 dagar vid fullt erfarenhetstillägg enligt AKTA.

VÅR VERKSAMHET
Vi skapar en kreativ och utvecklande miljö för barn 1-6 år, där omsorg, lek och lärande går hand i hand. Våra barngrupper består av 11-21 barn beroende på ålder, vilket ger både god personaltäthet och hög trivsel.

Vi ser varje barn som kompetent och unikt, och vill att alla ska känna sig sedda och bekräftade. Leken är hjärtat i lärandet - både fri lek inomhus och utomhus. Natur, rörelse, sagor, musik och kulturaktiviteter är viktiga delar av vår vardag, som stimulerar barnens nyfikenhet och glädje.

VILLKOR
Prövotid tillämpas
Tillträde enligt överenskommelse
Utdrag ur straffregistret krävs enligt lag innan anställning
Lön enligt avtal AKTA

SÅ ANSÖKER DU
Ansök via länken i annonsen och fyll i uppgifterna noggrant - din ansökan bedöms mot andra sökande. Efter första ansökan kan du logga in och uppdatera ditt CV för andra tjänster inom Mariehamns stad. Intervjuer kan hållas löpande under ansökningstiden.

jobs.title: Netkiosken på Kastetvej søger en butiksassistent og potentielt Souschef.
jobs.description:
Butiksassistent til Netkiosken Kastetvej/ Potentielt Souschef.

Netkiosken Kastetvej i Aalborg søger en butiksmedhjælper til faste vagter ca 20-25 timer ugentligt, primært i dagtimerne, men med en ugentlig aftenvagt. Til en person med de rette evner vil der med tiden være mulighed for at glide over i en stilling som Souschef med flere timer og højere løn.

Der vil være mulighed for flere timer om aftenen og i weekenden hvis man er klar på at hjælpe sine kolleger når de vil have byttet vagter eller ved sygdom. Fra midt november til midt januar forventer vi at du kan arbejde fuld tid, da denne periode er vores absolut travleste, idet ”Black Friday” er over os. Oplæringen forventes opstartet i begyndelsen af august.

Vi er en større kiosk i Aalborg, som har fokus på at tilfredsstille vore mange kunder. Vi tilbyder et stort udvalg af spilmuligheder, Danske spil, og Cashpoint samt mange spilleautomater. Ligeledes har vi et udvalg af kioskvarer og er pakkeshop for GLS, DAO, Post Nord, Bring, UPS og DHL. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bestå af kundeekspedition, vareopfyldning og diverse forefaldne opgaver. Med tiden vil flere ansvarsområder pålægges den ansatte hvis man har de rette evner. I sådanne tilfælde vil lønnen øges i forhold til det nedenstående. Ender man med at komme over i stillingen som Souschef, betyder det også, at man har telefonvagten hver anden uge og har ansvaret for at hjælpe personalet når de ringer om spørgsmål og møder op når det ikke kan løses via telefonen.

Arbejdstiderne er typisk hverdage i tidsrummet 8.00-17.00 Desuden ser vi gerne at du hjælper dine nye kollegaer en gang imellem med deres vagter samt lejlighedsvis hjælper ved sygdom hverdag, aftner og weekender. I ferieperioder vil der være mulighed for en del ekstra vagter.

Du skal være indstillet på at man periodevis arbejder alene og have autoritet samt god kundekontakt. Ligeledes skal du have overblik til at holde butikken pæn og ryddelig.

Stillingen er ideel for en der afholder et sabbatår, og erfaring fra tankstation eller supermarked vil være et plus. Hvis man ønsker at blive Souschef vil det være ønskeligt, at man har erfaring med at have personaleansvar fra tidligere stillinger.

Timelønnen er i prøvetiden, de første 3 måneder, 120 kr. Derefter 135kr. indtil første år og efter første år 145 kr. I tilfælde af at man bliver Souschef er lønnen selvfølgelig en anden og efter evner.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (80-100%), (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Reporting to the Head of HR Switzerland, you will provide HR Business Partner support to the Technology (R&D) and Service Divisions, as well as selected Corporate Functions including HR, Marketing & Communications and Legal, covering an employee population of around 260. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.



You benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits.

Modern office, smart working.

Flexible working models.

Canteen.

Employee Assistance Program.

Global parental leave program.

jobs.description:
Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.title: Technical Field Sales Representative (m/f/d) Denmark (Außendienstmitarbeiter/in)

egeplast is a highly innovative manufacturer of plastic pipe systems for underground utility infrastructure – ensuring a reliable supply of clean drinking water, heat and electricity, as well as access to high-speed internet. To support our team, we are looking for you as

Technical Field Sales Representative (m/f/d) Denmark

- You are the main contact person for our customers actively supporting and visiting them throughout the entire sales process.

jobs.title: 100% Remote Technical Implementation Manager (Hotel PMS / CRS Integration Specialist) EN (Hotelfachmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hotel Revenue Manager; Hotel Systems Experte

Stellenbeschreibung:
Hotel PMS use Experience Required (please do not apply if you have never used a hotel PMS)

Location: Fully Remote (EU preferred – Spain / Portugal / Southern Europe or global if compatible with EOR or contractor setup)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Flexible Hours)
Experience Level: Experience with hotel systems required
Salary Range: €30.000 - 45.000

Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered automation systems for the hospitality industry.

Our platform automatically reads incoming reservation emails and generates tailored offers for guests.

Unlike many traditional hotel systems, we work entirely with live real-time data from PMS, CRS, IBE, and Channel Manager APIs. Because of this, stable integrations and accurate data flow are critical to our product.

This is where this role comes in.

Job Summary

Are you the person at the hotel everyone turns to when the PMS stops syncing, the channel manager misbehaves, or integrations break?  This can be a great transition role into hotel tech from hotel operations

We are looking for a Hotel Systems Integration Specialist to take ownership of technical connectivity and implementation for our hotel partners.

This role is focused specifically on integration execution and system connectivity. You will work closely with our Account Management and Support teams, but you will not be responsible for commercial account management or first-line customer support. Your primary responsibility is ensuring that integrations between hotel systems and our platform are configured, tested, and functioning reliably.

You will also play an important internal role by helping our developers understand new PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager integrations — translating vendor documentation, operational workflows, and real-world hotel requirements into clear technical specifications and test scenarios.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Own Technical Onboarding
Lead the technical setup and activation of new hotel clients on our platform.

Ensure Reliable Connectivity
Configure, test, and validate integrations between our system and hotel PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager environments.

Translate Hotel Requirements into Technical Specs
When hotels request specific workflows (e.g. reservation field mapping, folio posting rules, or company profile handling), analyze whether and how their PMS APIs support it.

Work with API Documentation & Testing Tools
Use tools like Postman to test API endpoints, validate responses, and confirm system behavior before implementation.

Bridge to Engineering
Translate integration findings into clear, actionable specifications and GitLab tickets for the engineering team.

Troubleshoot Integration Issues
Investigate and resolve connectivity problems such as synchronization errors, missing reservation data, or incorrect folio postings.

Guide Hotel Technical Teams
Support hotel IT, revenue, or operations teams through setup steps such as API authentication (e.g. Microsoft Graph) and simple DNS configuration (e.g. CNAME records).

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

Experience with Hotel Systems Required
Previous experience working with hotel systems (such as PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, or other hotel operations platforms) is required.

Interface (API) Curiosity & Documentation Skills
Ability to read and interpret API documentation and figure out how to validate behavior using tools like Postman.

Technical Comfort (No Coding Required)
Comfort working with structured data (JSON/XML), basic API concepts, and technical troubleshooting workflows.

Strong Communication Skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both hotel operational teams and technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving Mindset
You enjoy investigating why systems don’t work and prefer practical solutions over theoretical perfection.

Fluent English
Written and spoken.  No German required.

Nice to Have (We Can Teach You)

- Experience using Postman for API testing
- Basic understanding of DNS / CNAME configuration
- Experience with PMS vendors such as Mews, Opera, Cloudbeds, Protel, SiteMinder, D-EDGE, SynXis, or Apaleo
- Previous experience in hotel tech (PMS, Channel Manager, CRS, IBE vendors)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 weeks, you will be independently:

- Onboarding and configuring hotel system integrations
- Testing API endpoints and validating integration behavior
- Translating hotel requirements into clear technical specifications
- Creating actionable engineering tickets for integration work
- Supporting live troubleshooting of connectivity issues

Culture & Working Style

We are a fully remote, international team operating in a trust-based environment.

We value:

- Remote & flexibility first – work from anywhere, structure your day how it works best for you
- High autonomy with high responsibility – you own your work end-to-end
- Strong error culture – mistakes are expected as part of learning; we focus on fixing and improving, not blaming
- Respectful communication – direct feedback is welcome, personal attacks are not
- Pragmatism over perfection – we prefer working systems over theoretical perfection

We work in a fast-moving environment where clarity improves over time through iteration, not upfront perfection.

Benefits

- Fully remote position
- Flexible working hours
- Direct access to engineering and product teams
- High autonomy and ownership
- Opportunity to grow into technical product or engineering roles
- Equipment provided (laptop + accessories if needed)

How to Apply

Please send your application to: career@hotelresbot.com

Please include:

- CV or short professional background
- Brief cover letter explaining: - Your experience with hotel systems (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, etc.)
- Your comfort level with reading API documentation and using tools like Postman
- Why you are interested in hotel SaaS implementation and connectivity

Ergänzende Informationen:
Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Datenaustauschformat JSON, Tourismusplattformen und Buchungssysteme
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Reservierung (Hotel- und Gaststättengewerbe), Hotelverwaltungs-, Reservierungssystem Opera

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Bäcker (m/w/d) / Baker (m/f/d) / Panadero/a (h/m/d) – Fuerteventura (Bäcker/in)
jobs.description:
Company

Für unseren Kunden, einen renommierten Anbieter im Premiumsegment der Tourismusbranche, suchen wir  engagierten und erfahrenen Bäcker (m/w/d) mit Leidenschaft für hochwertige Backwaren und einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsbewusstsein.

For our client, a renowned provider in the premium segment of the tourism industry, we are looking for a dedicated and experienced Baker (m/f/d) with a passion for high-quality baked goods and a strong sense of quality.

Para nuestro cliente, un reconocido proveedor en el segmento premium del sector turístico, buscamos un Panadero (h/m/d) comprometido y con experiencia, con pasión por productos de panadería de alta calidad y un fuerte sentido de la calidad.

Job Description

- Herstellung von Brot, Brötchen und weiteren Backwaren nach vorgegebenen Rezepturen.
- Produktion von frischen Backwaren in den frühen Morgenstunden.
- Sicherstellung von Qualität, Frische und ansprechender Präsentation der Produkte.
- Einhaltung von Hygiene- und Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsbereich.
- Kontrolle und Vorbereitung der benötigten Rohstoffe und Zutaten.
- Reinigung und Pflege der Backstube und der Arbeitsgeräte.
- Production of bread, rolls, and other baked goods according to given recipes.
- Preparation of fresh bakery products in the early morning hours.
- Ensuring quality, freshness, and attractive presentation of products.
- Compliance with hygiene and safety standards in the workplace.
- Control and preparation of required raw materials and ingredients.
- Cleaning and maintenance of the bakery area and equipment.
- Elaboración de pan, bollos y otros productos de panadería según recetas establecidas.
- Producción de productos frescos en las primeras horas de la mañana.
- Garantizar la calidad, frescura y presentación atractiva de los productos.
- Cumplimiento de las normas de higiene y seguridad en el lugar de trabajo.
- Control y preparación de las materias primas e ingredientes necesarios.
- Limpieza y mantenimiento del área de panadería y del equipo de trabajo.

Requirements

- Du hast mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Bäcker.
- Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst.
- Du bist bereit, in der Frühschicht von 02:00 bis 10:00 Uhr zu arbeiten.
- Du verfügst über einen gültigen PKW-Führerschein.
- Du sprichst Deutsch, Englisch oder Spanisch.
- Du bist teamfähig, belastbar und qualitätsorientiert.
- You have at least 3–5 years of professional experience as a baker.
- You work independently, reliably, and with a strong sense of responsibility.
- You are willing to work the early shift from 02:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m.
- You hold a valid car driving license.
- You speak German, English, or Spanish.
- You are a team player, resilient, and quality-oriented.
- Tienes al menos 3–5 años de experiencia profesional como panadero.
- Trabajas de manera autónoma, responsable y confiable.
- Estás dispuesto a trabajar en el turno de madrugada de 02:00 a 10:00.
- Posees un permiso de conducir válido.
- Hablas alemán, inglés o español.
- Eres una persona orientada a la calidad, trabajas bien en equipo y eres resistente al estrés.

Benefits

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in Vollzeit.
- 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
- Attraktive Vergütung von 1500 € – 1600 € netto monatlich.
- Kostenlose Unterkunft wird vom Arbeitgeber gestellt.
- Mahlzeiten in der Hotelkantine sowie alkoholfreie Getränke an der Bar.
- Nutzung des hauseigenen Fitnessstudios.
- An- und Abreise werden vom Arbeitgeber bezahlt.
- Arbeitsort auf Fuerteventura mit ganzjährig angenehmem Klima.
- Permanent full-time employment contract.
- 30 vacation days per year.
- Attractive net salary of €1500 – €1600 per month.
- Free accommodation provided by the employer.
- Meals in the hotel canteen and non-alcoholic drinks at the bar.
- Arrival and departure costs are covered by the employer.
- Access to the on-site gym.
- Work location in Fuerteventura with a pleasant climate all year round.
- Contrato indefinido a tiempo completo.
- 30 días de vacaciones al año.
- Salario atractivo de 1500 € – 1600 € netos al mes.
- Alojamiento gratuito proporcionado por el empleador.
- Comidas en la cantina del hotel y bebidas no alcohólicas en el bar.
- Los gastos de llegada y regreso son cubiertos por el empleador.
- Acceso al gimnasio del establecimiento.
- Lugar de trabajo en Fuerteventura con clima agradable durante todo el año.

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Dansk onlinecasino søger kundeservicemedarbejder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at få flere ansvarsområder i takt med dine præstationer og kompetencer.

Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

  • 150 euro til flybillet

  • Relocationpakke, så du kommer godt fra start med bolig

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

Lokation: Gzira, Malta. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

About OSI

OSI Europe is a leading company in the food industry, specializing in the production of high-quality food products. With several production sites in Europe and a global distribution network, we offer first-class solutions for customers worldwide.

Our European Headquarter in Gersthofen is looking for a** Project Management Specialist (m/f/d). **Possible other locations: Bábolna, Toledo, Ostróda, Enns, Günzburg, Duisburg.

What your job includes

- Responsibility over cost or efficiency evaluation projects: Volume movements, backup validations, contingency plans

jobs.title: Senior SCADA Consultant (m/f/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of renewable energy assets. We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.

Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.

The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations. As PEAK Wind is an international company, you need to have good English communication skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

jobs.title: Uimaopettaja ja/tai vauva- ja perheuinnin ohjaaja (TURKU)
jobs.description:
Tavallinen työ? Ei ihan.

Etsitkö pientä lisätyötä, jossa jokaisella työtunnilla on aito merkitys ja jossa pääset näkemään tuloksia välittömästi lasten ja perheiden riemuna?

Liikutaan ilosta Oy (GoBabyGo) on toiminut vuodesta 2015 lähtien pidettynä lastenliikunnan tarjoajana Turun alueella.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia uinti- ja liikuntaryhmiä reilusti yli 100 eri viikkotunnilla, ja kanssamme työskentelee ammattitaitoinen, noin 15 hengen ohjaajatiimi.

Meidän sydämenasiamme on luoda turvallisia, opettavaisia ja iloisia liikuntahetkiä vedessä sekä maalla. Kaikki ryhmämme ovat aina alusta loppuun ohjattuja sekä suunniteltuja kokonaisuuksia.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä viihtyisässä omassa toimipisteessämme Katariinakodissa (Meriläistentie 1, 20740 Turku).

Yksityinen allas on 33 °C lämmin ja syvenee 80–120 cm, mikä takaa täydellisen opetus- ja oppimisympäristön. Taataksemme parhaimman palvelun, pidämme ryhmäkoot pieninä (noin 10 lasta/ryhmä). Ohjattavat ryhmät ovat alkeisuimakoulusta tekniikkauimakouluun.

Lisäksi tuurausmahdollisuuksia on Esikon palvelutalolla (Vähäheikkilä) sekä kylpylähotelli Caribian vauva- ja perheuintiryhmissä.

Haemme nyt yhtä superenergistä aikuista ohjaajaa syyskaudesta 2026 alkaen. Syyskautemme starttaa elokuussa ja merkityksellinen työ voi alkaa tästä!

Sovit loistavasti meille, jos tunnistat itsesi näistä:

Sinulla on noin 3 vuotta työkokemusta alalta ja ohjauskielesi on Suomi.

Työ vaatii vahvaa oma-aloitteisuutta ja taitoa ohjata lapsi- ja perheryhmiä itsenäisesti ja varmasti. Odotammekin, että sinulla on kokemusta työskentelystä lasten kanssa ja kuuluva sekä selkeä ääni.

Sydämellistä asennetta! Olet aina iloinen, energinen ja aidosti lapsirakas aikuinen. Osaat kohdata lapset ja perheet lämpimästi.

Katsomme eduksi SUH:n uimaopettajan koulutuksen.

Arvostamme myös esimerkiksi omaa kilpauintitaustaa ohjauskokemuksen lisäksi sekä voimassa olevaa ensiapukoulutusta (EA-kortti).

Työajat ja palkkaus:

Kyseinen ohjausvuoro sijoittuu yhteen arki-iltaan klo 16.15–19.45, joten työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi opintojen, äitiysloman tai toisen työn rinnalle.

Tarjoamme joustavat palkkausvaihtoehdot tilanteesi mukaan:

Laskutuksella: 35 € / h (oman yrityksen tai kevytyrittäjäpalvelun kautta)

Verokortilla: 25 € / h (tai sopimuksen mukaan)

jobs.title: Senior AI Builder
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


The AI Studio is the team responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing internal software platforms across every functional department of the company, including People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Recruiting, and Executive Operations. We treat each internal department as its own product surface, and in truth as its own startup, with its own customers, its own metrics, and its own reasons for existing. We ship custom software, built on Replit’s own platform, to solve operational problems that off-the-shelf SaaS tools cannot serve well at our scale and pace of growth.





POSITION SUMMARY

The Member of Technical Staff (AI Builder) is a full-time builder role with substantial autonomy. You will design, architect, and ship AI-powered internal platforms that run the operations of the company across many departments at once. This is not a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined lane. It is a role for someone who wants to walk into an ambiguous business problem, understand it well enough to argue about it with the department lead, and then ship the software that fixes it.

We are looking for people who genuinely understand the mechanics of a business: how revenue is actually made, why recruiting velocity matters, what makes support scale or break, how finance closes a month, and why each department is critical to whether the company wins or loses. You do not need to have run every function, but you need to respect why each one exists and be able to reason about it like an operator, not just an engineer.

Because we treat each department as its own startup, we strongly favor people who have either run their own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup. You know what it feels like to build with incomplete information, to ship before it is comfortable, and to own an outcome rather than a ticket. The work is genuinely a ton of fun, and it is also demanding: it rewards diplomacy, creativity, technical depth, and business acumen in roughly equal measure. You will move fast, work long hours when it matters, and switch fluidly between a deep technical conversation and a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder who just needs their problem solved.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



INTERNAL PLATFORM DESIGN AND ENGINEERING

 - Design, architect, and ship custom AI-powered internal platforms that serve specific operational needs across Replit’s functional departments, including but not limited to People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Recruiting, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Operations.

 - Translate ambiguous, often non-technical business requirements into technical specifications, system architectures, and shipped software products.

 - Own platform development end-to-end, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, data models, third-party integrations, and AI model orchestration.

Applied AI and Large Language Model Engineering

 - Architect multi-stage AI pipelines incorporating large language models, including prompt engineering, tool-call architecture, structured output generation, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflows.

 - Conduct model selection across multiple frontier and open-source providers, evaluating models against cost per query, latency, output quality, reliability, and task-specific performance.

 - Design and implement evaluation frameworks for AI features, including test datasets, scoring rubrics, and regression tests, so that AI-driven workflows stay reliable in production.

 - Optimize AI systems for cost and performance, including the appropriate use of lighter-weight models for qualification passes, batching strategies for high-throughput workloads, and caching architectures.

Business Understanding and Stakeholder Partnership

 - Treat each internal department as its own startup: understand its goals, its constraints, and the metrics that define whether it is succeeding.

 - Partner directly with department leads to identify operational inefficiencies, scope solutions, and prioritize the work that creates the most leverage.

 - Conduct stakeholder interviews, lead requirements-gathering sessions, and translate qualitative feedback into iterative product improvements.

 - Present technical work and operational outcomes to executive leadership, including the President and senior staff, and do it in language each audience can act on.

Third-Party System Integration

 - Design and implement integrations with the third-party platforms used at Replit, including enterprise HR platforms, support ticketing systems, CRM platforms, applicant tracking systems, project management tools, and identity providers.

 - Evaluate third-party APIs, SDKs, and data schemas, and design integration architectures appropriate to scale, security, and maintainability requirements.

Production Operations and Reliability

 - Maintain and operate shipped platforms in production, including dependency management, security updates, observability, error handling, and performance monitoring.

 - Respond to production incidents and continuously iterate on shipped platforms based on user feedback and operational telemetry.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

 - Document architectural decisions, system designs, and operational procedures for shipped platforms.

 - Onboard future team members and contribute to the evolution of the AI Studio as the function scales.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You understand how a business actually works and can explain why each department matters to the company winning.

 - You have either run your own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup, and you carry the ownership instinct that comes with it.

 - You are comfortable with long hours and a very high pace, and you treat that as part of the fun rather than a cost.

 - You can engage credibly with both deeply technical people and non-technical stakeholders, often in the same afternoon.

 - You bring diplomacy, creativity, technical knowledge, and business acumen, and you know when each one is the tool the moment calls for.

 - You would rather ship something real and iterate than wait for perfect information.
   
   


EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Technology Management, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical or technology-business hybrid field. Equivalent foreign degrees acceptable subject to credential evaluation. Exceptional non-traditional backgrounds with a strong shipped portfolio will be considered.

 - A demonstrated portfolio of shipped software products, including AI-powered applications, and the ability to discuss technical architecture, design trade-offs, and engineering decisions in detail.

 - Experience either running your own business or working at a fast-scaling startup, with real exposure to how the business operated end-to-end.

 - Working proficiency in modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and production debugging.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more large language model providers and their APIs, tool-calling interfaces, and structured output mechanisms.

 - Demonstrated experience designing prompt and tool-call architectures, conducting model selection across providers, and optimizing AI systems for cost and latency.

 - Programming proficiency in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, including familiarity with relevant frameworks for AI application development.

 - Experience with relational databases, SQL, and modern data tooling.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical work to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience as a founder, co-founder, or early team member at a venture-backed startup, particularly one with an AI-native product.

 - Prior experience in technology investment analysis or operational consulting, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate business operations and identify high-leverage interventions.

 - Hands-on experience building on the Replit platform, including familiarity with Replit Agent and Replit Deployments.

 - Experience designing and shipping internal tools at a high-growth technology company.

 - Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to Replit’s international customer base, including Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, or other major commercial languages.

 - Experience with mobile application development frameworks, including React Native and Expo.
   
   


TRAVEL AND LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

This position is based in Foster City, California, with secondary work performed at the company’s San Francisco, California office. The company operates on a hybrid in-person schedule, with employees expected to be in-office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in Foster City, and Tuesday and Thursday in San Francisco. Occasional domestic travel may be required for company offsites and customer engagements.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive  - Belgium & Luxembourg (Paris / Lille area based)
2 three-year postdocs in political communication and political psychology at Aarhus University
jobs.description:
The Department of Political Science, Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for two three-year full-time postdoctoral researchers to join the research project “The Politics of Shaming and Shamelessness: How Elite Rhetoric Fuels Hostility and Tolerance for Political Violence”, funded by the Carlsberg Foundation (Semper Ardens: Accelerate) and headed by Associate Professor Tobias Widmann. The starting date is flexible and subject to mutual agreement but expected to be between December 2026 and February 2027.

The project
Healthy political discourse is the lifeblood of democracy. Yet across Western democracies, discourse has grown markedly more hostile, and physical assaults on politicians, attacks on minorities, and mobs storming legislatures show how hostility increasingly spills over into political violence. The project examines how elites, through their rhetoric, contribute to this development. It focuses on the emotion of shame and two connected rhetorical practices that have been on the rise over the last decades: shaming, where elites publicly brand opponents as norm violators and threats to the moral fabric of society, and shamelessness, where elites reassure their supporters that stigmatized beliefs or behaviors are normal or even honorable. These practices do not merely express disagreement – they recalibrate what counts as legitimate behavior and instruct citizens on which actions should be punished or excused.

The project is organized around three work packages. Work package I develops computational tools to detect and quantify shaming and shamelessness in elite political discourse across advanced democracies. Work package II examines the causal consequences of elite shaming and shamelessness for citizens’ discursive norms, hostility in debate, and tolerance of political violence. Work package III develops and tests remedies against the harmful effects of this rhetoric, using generative agent-based simulations and AI-chatbot-based dialogue experiments.

The two postdocs advertised in this call will take on leading roles in the empirical work of the project, with different but complementary profiles. Both postdocs are expected to have an affinity to computational methods and tools. The project is funded by a Carlsberg Foundation Semper Ardens: Accelerate grant, an ambitious funding instrument supporting research of high international standing led by mid-career researchers. The project runs for four years from August 2026 to July 2030 and is carried out by a team of two postdocs and student assistants led by Associate Professor Tobias Widmann.

The positions
Postdoc 1 will focus on the development and application of computational tools in the project. This includes, first and foremost, computational text analysis to detect shaming and shamelessness in parliamentary debates, party manifestos, press releases, and elite social-media content. It also includes other forms of computational tools used in the project, such as generative agent-based simulations with LLM-powered agents and AI-chatbot-based dialogue interventions. The postdoc will lead the empirical work on work package I and contribute to the computational components of work packages II and III.

Postdoc 2 will focus on the experimental and quasi-experimental work of the project. This includes designing and implementing online and mock social-media experiments, developing causal identification strategies in observational data, and conducting human experiments with AI chatbots as adaptive dialogue interventions. The postdoc will lead the empirical work on work packages II and III, with a strong emphasis on research design and causal inference.

Both postdocs are expected to combine their respective methodological profiles with an active interest in computational tools. They will be part of a collaborative team including the PI and student assistants. Research will primarily be carried out in collaboration with other project members. In addition, the positions involve opportunities to pursue independent work within the overall focus of the project. The successful applicant will become part of an exciting and ambitious research project and a supportive research team with a collegial and respectful atmosphere. There will be excellent opportunities for intellectual development and mentoring, with a focus on how the candidate can make use of the postdoctoral position to develop their career.

In addition to the outlined research tasks, the position implies modest teaching obligations equivalent to one course per year.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold a PhD in political science or a closely related discipline (e.g., communication, sociology, computational social science, psychology) by the starting date of the position. We are looking for outstanding candidates who can demonstrate:

  • A strong record (relative to career stage) of research on political communication, political behavior, political psychology, or a closely related area.

  • An affinity to computational tools and methods, and strong programming skills (e.g., Python and/or R).

  • Familiarity with research on emotions, social norms, incivility, or political violence.

  • High level of professional English proficiency, both written and oral.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international team.

  • Experience with or interest in comparative research across multiple democracies.


For Postdoc 1, we particularly look for:

  • Documented experience with computational text analysis, including natural language processing and the use of (multilingual) large language models / transformer-based models.

  • Experience with large-scale data collection (e.g., parliamentary speeches, manifestos, press releases, social-media data).

  • Interest in or experience with other computational tools relevant to the project, such as generative agent-based simulations or LLM-based conversational interventions.


For Postdoc 2, we particularly look for:

  • Documented experience with experimental and/or quasi-experimental research design.

  • Strong skills in statistical analysis and causal inference.

  • Experience with or demonstrated interest in LLM-based methods, including the use of conversational AI or generative agents in experimental settings.


Applicants are welcome to indicate whether they wish to be considered for one specific position or for both.

What we offer

  • A project that studies a highly relevant and societally important issue

  • A work environment at one of Europe’s leading political science departments with a vibrant, supportive, and collegial atmosphere

  • Excellent development opportunities and research support, including funding for data collection, conferences/travel, and research assistance

  • Competitive salary


Further information
For further information about the project and the positions, please contact Associate Professor Tobias Widmann at widmann@ps.au.dk.

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, don’t hesitate to contact HR coordinator Astrid Valdgård Schmidt at avs@au.dk.

Place of work
Department of Political Science, Bartholins Allé 7, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Application deadline
Applications must be submitted before the deadline of 31 August 2026. Candidates selected for interviews are expected to be contacted by the end of September.

Who we are
With around 130 academic staff members and 40 PhD students, the Department of Political Science is among Europe’s largest political science departments. The research at the department covers most political science disciplines, including public administration, and represents a variety of methodological approaches. We are among Europe’s highest-ranked departments, and our broad research profile enables us to focus on societal problems as they appear in the national and international political arena. This allows us to contribute actively to the development of the discipline. We offer a lively and ambitious research and teaching environment characterized by pluralism and openness. We expect active participation in the activities of the department, which includes being present at the department at least three days per week.

For more information about the Department of Political Science, please see here.

The Department of Political Science is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here:
http://talent.au.dk/junior-researcher-development-programme/

Terms of employment
The appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish).
The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

  • Application

jobs.title: Avdelingsingeniør
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter deg som er vår nye og engasjerte kollega!  

Hos oss vil du være med på å bygge kommunen med et langsiktig utviklingsperspektiv. Med denne stillingen søker vi å styrke vår kompetanse og kapasitet innen saksbehandling og oppfølging av veg og grøntområder.

Her hos oss vil du jobbe sammen med en super og livlig gjeng, proppfull av ulik faglig kompetanse. 
Stillingen vil ligge til forvaltningsavdelingen i virksomhet for miljø og samferdsel. Avdelingen jobber med flere fagområder innen vei, grønt, klima og miljø.

Utvikling og forvaltning av kommunal samferdsel, grøntområder, friareal og idrettsareal er en primæroppgave for avdelingen. I tillegg til oppfølging av lovverk knyttet til vei og friluft, samt kommunens rolle som grunneier av slike områder, arbeider avdelingen tverrfaglig med eksterne og interne samarbeidspartnere for å bidra til en overordnet og helhetlig planlegging av samferdsel og blågrønn infrastruktur.

Blant annet har vi et tett samarbeid med prosjektavdelingen og driftsavdelingen i miljø og samferdsel, samt Bypakke Ålesund. Hele virksomheten bidrar også til å nå kommunens mål innen natur, klima og miljø. 


Arbeidsoppgaver

I hovedsak vil oppgavene være saksbehandling knyttet til forvaltning av kommunalt vegnett og friområder
Saksbehandlingen er særlig rettet mot graveløyver, arbeidsløyver, arbeidsvarsling, permanent skilting og vedtak etter bla. veglova
Dialog og samhandling med aktuelle faggrupper, både internt og eksternt 
Andre oppgaver vil kunne tillegges stillingen 

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Krav til utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå fra høgskole/universitet eller annen relevant teknisk bakgrunn
  • Ønske om vegfaglig kompetanse 
  • Ønske om erfaring med trafikksikkerhetsarbeid 
  • Krav om å mestre norsk skriftlig og muntlig 
  • Krav til førerkort klasse B 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Faglig engasjert, nysgjerrig, motivert og med en positiv innstilling 
  • Strukturert, løsningsorientert og selvstendig 
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsegenskaper 
  • Stor gjennomføringsevne 
  • Personlige egenskaper vil bli vektlagt 
Vi tilbyr
  • Faglig spennende og varierte oppgaver 
  • Godt tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø 
  • God tilrettelegging for faglig utvikling 
  • 100 % stilling 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger 
  • Fleksitid og gode arbeidsvilkår 
KontaktinformasjonIda Morsund, Avd. leder, ida.morsund@alesund.kommune.no
ArbeidsstadKeiser Wilhelms gate 11
6003 ÅLESUND
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Kommunalområde Samfunn

Referansenr.: 5155819875
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 23.08.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen i Møre og Romsdal og den største byen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, med ca. 60 000 innbyggere.

Det lokale næringslivet er både lokalt, nasjonalt og ikke minst internasjonalt orientert. Ålesund er «bygget» på fiske og fangst. Fremdeles er Ålesundsregionen verdensledende innen det marine og maritime området. Flere av landets største fiskebedrifter og oppdrettsselskaper holder til i kommunen vår. Ålesund har Norges største cruisehavn, største fiskerihavn og nest største containerhavn. Vi er også Norges største eksporthavn for fiskeprodukter.

Kommunen er det største kollektivknutepunktet i fylket, og tall fra 2016 viser at det årlig er rundt to millioner passasjerer som går av eller på en buss eller båt i Ålesund.

Ålesund by er vidt kjent for sin vakre jugendstil. Tårn, spir og vakre utsmykninger møter deg når du går gatelangs der. Byen ligger som en døråpner til fjordsystemet på Sunnmøre og strekker seg helt nord til Ona utenfor Romsdalskysten. Andre attraksjoner i kommunen er Ona fyr og fantastiske fjell, fjorder og natur rett utenfor stuedøren.

Vi er en universitetskommune og har et nært samarbeid med NTNU på Campus Ålesund. På Campus Ålesund finner du også Ålesund framtidslab – U4SSC IP.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4 400 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Experienced butchers to Denmark
jobs.description:
If you have two or more years of professional deboning experience and are ready to take on a well-paying role in one of Denmark's largest slaughterhouses, this position has been built for you.

Barona Teollisuus Oy is a Finnish staffing and recruitment company that places skilled professionals in industrial and production roles across Europe. In this role, you will be working in a large, professionally managed slaughterhouse environment in Denmark, with full administrative support every step of the way.

All the necessary paperwork will be handled on your behalf - including your CPR number, tax card, health insurance registration, and Danish bank account - so you can focus entirely on your work from day one.

Both seasonal and permanent positions are available.

Working times are 40h/week in day shift, and 32h/week in the evening shift.

Apply via Barona Careers. For questions about the role or the application process, please refer to the contact details in the full job description below.

YOUR TASKS

You will work as an experienced butcher in the deboning department of one of the largest slaughterhouses in Denmark. Your work is focused, skilled, and performed to a high professional standard.

- You will perform shoulder deboning of pork according to established production procedures
- You will maintain consistent quality and precision throughout your work shift
- You will follow workplace health, safety, and hygiene regulations at all times
- You will work as part of a professional production team in a high-volume environment
- You will report any irregularities or quality issues to your supervisor

REQUIREMENTS

- A minimum of two years of professional experience in shoulder deboning (pork)
- Demonstrated ability to work at a consistent pace in a production environment
- Proficiency in English or Danish - sufficient for workplace communication
- Willingness to relocate to Denmark for the duration of the contract
- Reliability, attention to detail, and a strong professional work ethic

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working in large-scale industrial slaughterhouse environments
- Familiarity with Danish or Nordic workplace culture and practices
- Previous experience working abroad or in international teams

WHAT WE OFFER

- Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.
- After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework, where the hourly rate will increase significantly. Can be around 3000€ a month.
- Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance
- Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)
- Both seasonal and permanent positions available
- First month of accommodation provided free of charge - single rooms in shared houses or apartments, located within a maximum 30-minute drive from the slaughterhouse
- Assistance securing affordable car rental at approximately DKK 3,000 per month per vehicle, with the option to share costs among colleagues
- Full administrative support: your CPR number, tax card, health insurance registration, Danish bank account, and all other required formalities will be handled for you.

If you are interested, send your application with CV right away!

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, designing and implementing solutions to unlock our sales team. Your knowledge of sales processes will be instrumental in implementing critical systems to unlock our business goals.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with RevOps, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to turn real deal friction into durable systems: clearer processes, smarter automation, and a quoting experience that helps the team move faster with confidence.


This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Analyze business processes and sales systems to identify improvement opportunities

 - Independently drive tasks and projects end to end (requirements, analysis, design, implementation, thorough testing, launch, and ongoing support).

 - Manage Salesforce configuration through a governed change management process - building and maintaining Flows, custom objects, validation rules, and security controls with sandbox-first development, documentation, and aligned with platform best practices.

 - Collaborate proactively with business stakeholders and the Corporate Systems team to deliver durable solutions.

 - Partner with senior admins and developers to configure solutions across core CRM data models (Accounts, Opportunities, lead-to-opportunity processes, and related custom objects).

 - Support stakeholders with day-to-day system questions, unblock workflows, and become a trusted Salesforce admin partner

 - Ensure thorough testing, documentation, and clear communication for all system changes.

 - Look for everyday ways AI can accelerate your work, simplify seller processes, and reduce manual steps.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL BRING

 - You are Salesforce Admin certified.

 - 7+ years of experience as a Sales Business Systems Analyst and/or providing Salesforce support.

 - Experience with a CPQ implementation and deep knowledge of quote-to-cash (and other sales functional processes).

 - Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud best practices, including building Flows, validation rules, and reports.

 - AI-native builder mindset: comfortable using AI tools to accelerate development, generate code, build agents, and draft clear requirements; eager to keep leveling up.

 - Ability to map processes and translate needs into user stories, with strong stakeholder collaboration.

 - Experience working in Agile environments and partnering effectively with development teams.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Certified Salesforce CPQ Specialist



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $145,000-$170,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Byg stabile systemer, der bruges hver dag i virkeligheden

Er du en backend-udvikler, der går op i struktur, datakvalitet og løsninger, der holder i drift – ikke bare i teorien? Vil du arbejde med et produkt, som bliver brugt aktivt af virksomheder og stiller krav til stabilitet, performance og gennemtænkte workflows? Så er du måske vores næste udvikler hos ClinicDrive.

Om ClinicDrive

ClinicDrive er en dansk SaaS-virksomhed med base i Vejle, stiftet i 2020. Vi udvikler en platform til tandlægeklinikker, som samler drift, opgavestyring, vagtplaner og compliance i ét system. Vores løsning er en central del af kundernes hverdag, og det stiller høje krav til stabilitet, datakvalitet og gennemtænkt forretningslogik. Du bliver en del af et lille ambitiøst team, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til implementering – og hvor du får reel indflydelse på både teknik og produkt.

Rollen

Du bliver en del af backend-kernen og arbejder med:

·       Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores Laravel / Angular-baserede platform

·       Design og implementering af REST APIs

·       Datamodellering og optimering af MySQL

·       Opbygning af robuste workflows og forretningslogik

·       Løbende forbedring af performance og kodekvalitet

Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores Product Owner og resten af teamet

Tech stack

Vi arbejder primært med PHP (Laravel), MySQL og REST APIs som fundament. Derudover bruger vi Git (GitHub) i vores daglige udvikling. Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med Angular og TypeScript, CI/CD eller test (unit/integration).

Vi leder efter dig, som

·       Har 2–5 års erfaring med backend udvikling

·       Er stærk i PHP og Laravel

·       Har solid forståelse for databasedesign (MySQL)

·       Erfaring med test (unit/integration)

·       Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

·       Tænker i løsninger – ikke kun kode

·       Trives i et mindre team med højt tempo

Det er et plus, hvis du også:

·       Angular / TypeScript

·       Erfaring med CI/CD

·       Har arbejdet med cloud (AWS)

·       Har erfaring med agile processer

·       Er nysgerrig på automatisering og nye teknologier (fx AI i praksis)

Hvad du får

·       Reelt ansvar og indflydelse på produktet

·       Kort vej fra idé til implementering

·       Et uformelt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø

·       Et teknisk stærkt team med fokus på kvalitet

Payroll Assistant | Finance Team

Location: Leyland & Skelmersdale

Full Time 37.5 Hours (MAT COVER FTC 12 Months)

Love a streamlined process? Let’s make sure our payroll is as polished as our products.

At VictorianPlumbing.co.uk we’re experts in helping our customers create their dream bathrooms. But behind every sleek tap and designer tub is a Finance team that keeps the water running smoothly.

We are looking for a diligent, detail-oriented Payroll Assistant to join our team. If you have a passion for precision and want to ensure our staff are paid as reliably as a high-pressure shower, this is the role for you. No "leaks" in data, no "clogs" in the system—just smooth, accurate payroll.

The Role: Making a Splash in Finance

Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you’ll be the go-to person for our end-to-end payroll services. You’ll ensure every member of the team is paid accurately and on time, maintaining full compliance with statutory regulations.

Your daily flow will include:

  • Data Processing: Handling the "plumbing" of our monthly payroll—collating data for new starters, leavers, and overtime claims.

  • Statutory Compliance: Calculating SSP, SMP, and SPP with total accuracy, ensuring Income Tax and National Insurance deductions are spot on.

  • Pension Administration: Assisting with workplace schemes and auto-enrolment, ensuring contributions are uploaded without a hitch.

  • Query Resolution: Being the first point of contact for staff queries. Whether it’s a tax code change or a payslip discrepancy, you’ll provide clear, helpful answers.

  • System Maintenance: Keeping our HR and Finance systems sparkling and up-to-date through regular audits.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just "go with the flow" but actively manages the details. You’ll need:

  • UK Payroll Experience: Proven experience in a UK-based payroll or finance function is essential.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: A solid grasp of RTI, P60/P45 processing, and year-end procedures.

  • Technical Ability: You are highly proficient in payroll software (Sage, Iris, Workday, etc.) and an Excel expert—VLOOKUPs and pivot tables are your bread and butter.

  • Communication: A professional manner and the ability to handle sensitive information with total discretion.

  • Qualifications: A CIPP qualification (or the ambition to study for one) is highly desirable.

Why Dive In With Us?

You’ll be joining a fast-growing online retailer where your hard work is visible and valued. We offer a supportive environment where you can truly "soak up" new skills and grow your career.

Ready to dive into a new challenge?

jobs.description:
Brænder du for værtskab, gæsteservice og ledelse? Har du et godt overblik og lyst til at være med til at skabe uforglemmelige oplevelser for vores gæster?

Så er du måske den Receptionschef, vi søger til Femø Kro & Feriecenter.

Om stillingen

Som Receptionschef bliver du ansigtet udadtil og får ansvaret for den daglige drift af receptionen. Du er den, der sikrer, at vores gæster bliver mødt med et smil, professionel service og en varm velkomst – fra booking til afrejse.

Du bliver en central del af vores team og får en varieret hverdag, hvor du både arbejder operationelt i receptionen og har ansvar for at koordinere og udvikle den daglige drift.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Ledelse og koordinering af den daglige drift i receptionen

  • Ind- og udtjekning af hotel- og feriecenterets gæster

  • Håndtering af bookinger via telefon, e-mail og bookingsystem

  • Besvarelse af gæstehenvendelser før, under og efter ophold

  • Sikre en høj service- og kvalitetsstandard

  • Planlægning af vagtplaner og koordinering af receptionens medarbejdere

  • Klargøring og koordinering af morgenbuffeten

  • Tæt koordinering med rengøring, køkken og øvrige afdelinger for at sikre, at gæsterne møder høj kvalitet og god service under hele opholdet.

  • Administrative opgaver samt optimering af arbejdsgange

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har ledelsesevner og trives med personaleansvar (ledelseserfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen)

  • Er serviceminded, smilende og imødekommende

  • Er struktureret og trives med mange bolde i luften

  • Har kendskab til IT og lærer hurtigt nye systemer

  • Kan bevare overblikket – også når der er travlt

  • Er fleksibel og indstillet på weekend- og aftenvagter

  • Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende lederstilling med stor indflydelse på den daglige drift

  • En arbejdsplads med nærvær, gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på receptionen og gæsteoplevelsen

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • Mulighed for bolig på Femø Kro & Feriecenter i forbindelse med ansættelsen

  • Ansættelse hurtigst muligt

Om Femø Kro & Feriecenter
